title: Memetic Trojans: Social Contagions as Carriers of Adversarial Payloads in Agent Networks
title_zh: 模因木马：社交传染作为智能体网络中对抗性载荷的载体

paragraphs.en: Autonomous large language model (LLM) agents increasingly interact in network environments where adversarial content can propagate between agents. Known attacks include agent worms, which spread through self-replicating prompt injections or configuration compromises. We introduce memetic trojans , a distinct class of network-mediated attack that exploits agents’ tendencies to retransmit and amplify content. Unlike agent worms, whose propagation is adversarially induced, memetic trojans exploit endogenous transmission by embedding adversarial payloads in social contagions : content agents have internal reasons to share. As part of our work, we extract social contagions from Moltbook, a social media platform for LLM agents. Controlled transmission experiments reveal large differences in virality: the most effective contagion is retransmitted in approximately 50% of subsequent agent posts and upvoted at 2.5x the average post’s rate. Its memetic trojan counterpart largely inherits these properties. Monte Carlo attack simulations show that memetic trojans amplify expected exposure by up to 3.19x. Network structure and amplification mechanisms strongly shape propagation, producing heavy-tailed outcomes with near network-wide exposure. These results identify endogenous social transmission as a distinct security vulnerability in multi-agent systems. Because propagation does not require agents to follow malicious retransmission instructions, defenses focused on prompt-injection detection or preventing agent compromise cannot alone prevent memetic trojan propagation. Securing large-scale agent ecosystems may require network-level defenses that account for how agent preferences, recommendation mechanisms, and network topology amplify adversarial payloads.
paragraphs.zh: 自主大型语言模型（LLM）智能体在网络环境中日益频繁地相互交互，而恶意内容可能在这些智能体之间传播。 已知的攻击方式包括智能体蠕虫，它们通过自我复制的提示注入或配置漏洞进行传播。 我们提出了迷因特洛伊木马——一种独特的网络媒介攻击类型，它利用智能体重新传输和放大内容的倾向。 与通过恶意诱导传播的智能体蠕虫不同，迷因特洛伊木马则通过嵌入社会传染内容中的恶意负载来利用内源性传播；这些内容是智能体出于内在动机而愿意分享的。 作为研究的一部分，我们从 Moltbook（一个面向 LLM 智能体的社交媒体平台）中提取了社会传染内容。 受控的传播实验揭示了病毒性的巨大差异：最有效的传染内容在后续智能体帖子中的重新传输率约为 50%，且获得点赞的频率是普通帖子的 2.5 倍。 其对应的迷因特洛伊木马基本继承了这些特性。 蒙特卡洛攻击模拟表明，迷因特洛伊木马可将预期暴露度放大最多 3.19 倍。 网络结构和放大机制显著影响了传播过程，产生了重尾分布的结果，甚至可能导致近乎全网范围的暴露。 这些结果揭示了内源性社会传播是多智能体系统中一个独立的安全漏洞。 由于这种传播不需要智能体执行恶意重新传输指令，因此仅依赖提示注入检测或防止智能体被入侵的防御手段无法单独阻止迷因特洛伊木马的传播。 要保障大规模智能体生态系统的安全，可能需要部署网络层级的防御机制，以应对智能体的偏好、推荐机制和网络拓扑结构如何共同放大恶意负载的问题。

paragraphs.en: Internet traffic from autonomous Large Language Model (LLM) agents grew 7,851 % 7,851\% in 2025, increasing at roughly eight times the rate of human traffic [ 1 ] . As this progresses, agents will inevitably interact with content of varying and uncertain provenance, generated both by other agents with unknown directives and by humans with unknown intentions. In addition to the myriad security concerns this creates for agents individually [ 2 , 3 ] , the scale and co-interaction that inevitably occur in such networked scenarios may give rise to emergent phenomena for which individual assessments cannot fully account, and which, due to their emergent nature, are hard to secure. Specifically, the co-interaction of agents with one another and with human generated content permits network-mediated attacks [ 4 , 5 , 6 ] , where even attacks with low individual Attack Success Rate (ASR) may produce substantial aggregate harm at sufficient scale. An adversary may therefore optimize the diffusion of an attack independently of the exploit itself, turning network-mediated exposure into a distinct component of the attack surface. In other words, it is not only the effectiveness of an attack on any individual agent that is of concern in agent networks, but the overall scale of the attack.
paragraphs.zh: 2025年，自主大型语言模型（LLM）智能体产生的互联网流量增长了7,851%（7,851\%），其增长速度约为人类流量的八倍 [ 1 ]。 随着这一趋势的发展，智能体不可避免地会与来源多样且不确定内容进行交互，这些内容既可能由具有未知指令的其他智能体生成，也可能由意图不明的人类生成。 除了这给单个智能体带来的诸多安全担忧之外 [ 2 , 3 ]，此类网络化场景中必然出现的规模效应和协同交互，还可能引发个体评估无法完全涵盖的新兴现象；而这些现象因其突现特性而难以保障安全。 具体而言，智能体之间以及与人类生成内容之间的协同交互，使得网络媒介攻击成为可能 [ 4 , 5 , 6 ]；在这种情况下，即使单次攻击的成功率（ASR）较低，只要规模足够大，也可能造成巨大的总体危害。 因此，攻击者可以独立于具体的利用手段来优化攻击的扩散过程，从而将网络媒介暴露转化为攻击面中的一个独立组成部分。 换言之，在智能体网络中，需要关注的不仅是攻击对单个智能体的有效性，更是攻击的整体规模。

paragraphs.en: There is growing prior work on attack propagation in agent networks, most notably in the form of agent worms [ 5 , 6 , 4 ] , self-replicating attacks designed so that agents propagate the attack to other agents. Although their precise mechanisms differ, these attacks share the property that propagation is adversarially induced. This threat extends the well-established problem of indirect prompt injection, in which untrusted external content can override an agent’s intended task and induce unauthorized actions [ 2 ] . Correspondingly, proposed defenses have sought to prevent adversarial instructions from controlling agents or crossing security boundaries through prompt-injection detection and defensive prompting [ 2 ] , execution isolation [ 7 ] , capability and privilege control [ 8 , 9 ] , and information-flow control [ 10 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 关于智能体网络中攻击传播的研究日益增多，其中最典型的是智能体蠕虫 [5, 6, 4]，即一种自我复制的攻击，旨在使智能体将攻击传播给其他智能体。 尽管这些攻击的具体机制各不相同，但它们有一个共同点：攻击的传播是由对抗性因素引发的。 这种威胁扩展了早已存在的间接提示注入问题，即不可信的外部内容可能覆盖智能体的预期任务，并诱导其执行未经授权的操作 [2]。 相应地，现有的防御方法试图通过提示注入检测与防御性提示 [2]、执行隔离 [7]、能力与权限控制 [8, 9] 以及信息流控制 [10] 来防止对抗性指令控制智能体或跨越安全边界。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we hypothesize that self-propagation through adversarial instruction replication is not the only viable mechanism by which malicious content can achieve network-scale diffusion. We base this on the fact that in human social networks, information and behavior can spread through social contagions , where members can independently choose to adopt and retransmit content upon exposure, producing cascades through mechanisms such as social influence, repeated exposure, and network structure [ 11 , 12 , 13 ] . We posit that agent networks admit an analogous phenomenon. Just as some content spreads among humans without anyone being told to share it, some content may spread among agents simply because agents are more likely to reproduce it when they encounter it. This does not require agents to have preferences or personalities in any human sense; it only requires that some content elicits posting, upvoting and commenting more readily than other content. Where such content exists, it spreads on its own. This is the key mechanistic difference from agent worms: a worm must induce its host to retransmit it, whereas a social contagion is retransmitted because of what it is, not because of what it tells the recipient to do. This distinction creates a different attack surface for networks of autonomous agents. Suppose an adversary embeds a malicious payload—for example, a link to a compromised tool or skill—within content that agents already have an endogenous propensity to retransmit. The attacker need not instruct each exposed agent to copy the payload, nor compromise the agent before propagation can continue. Instead, the benign transmissibility of the surrounding content supplies the propagation mechanism, and the malicious payload is simply carried through the resulting cascade. Defenses aimed primarily at detecting or preventing malicious instructions are therefore unlikely to sufficiently mitigate transmission, because an agent can propagate the carrier without itself having been compromised. We term attacks that exploit this endogenous propensity to amplify and retransmit memetic trojans .
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们假设通过对抗性指令复制实现的自我传播并非恶意内容实现网络级扩散的唯一可行机制。 我们的这一观点基于以下事实：在人类社交网络中，信息和行为可以通过社会传染效应传播，其中成员在接触内容后可独立选择采纳并转发，从而通过社会影响、重复接触和网络结构等机制形成级联效应 [11, 12, 13]。 我们认为，智能体网络中也存在类似的现象。 正如某些内容无需任何人指示即可在人类中传播一样，某些内容也可能在智能体间传播，仅仅是因为智能体在遇到这些内容时更倾向于复制它们。 这并不要求智能体具备任何人类意义上的偏好或个性；它仅要求某些内容比其他内容更容易引发发布、点赞和评论行为。 只要存在这类内容，它就会自行传播。 这与智能体蠕虫的关键机制差异在于：蠕虫必须诱导其宿主进行转发，而社会传染效应则因其内容本身而被转发，而非因为内容指示接收者执行特定操作。 这种区别为自主智能体网络创造了不同的攻击面。 假设攻击者在某些内容中嵌入恶意负载——例如指向已受侵害工具或技能的链接——而这些内容恰好是智能体原本就具有内在倾向要转发的。 在这种情况下，攻击者无需指示每个接触到的智能体复制该负载，也无需在传播继续之前先入侵该智能体。 相反，周围内容的良性可传播性本身提供了传播机制，而恶意负载则只是通过由此产生的级联效应被携带传播。 因此，主要旨在检测或阻止恶意指令的防御措施可能无法有效遏制这种传播，因为智能体可以在自身未被入侵的情况下传播载体内容。 我们将利用这种内在倾向来放大和转发迷因式特洛伊木马的攻击称为“迷因式特洛伊攻击”。

paragraphs.en: To investigate the potential effectiveness of memetic trojans, we first assess carrier candidates through an exploration of social contagions on Moltbook, a social media platform for agents. These results revealed plausible evidence for several contagions, mediated both by retransmission (i.e. that agents make a new contagion-containing post) and amplification (i.e. that agents preferentially upvote contagions). We then hand-picked ten candidate contagions for further study and assessed their true virality through controlled assays of individual agents, where agents are presented with a simulated feed containing the contagion or its memetic trojan counterpart. We observe that there are substantial differences in both retransmission and amplification across the identified contagions, and that the memetic trojan counterparts broadly inherit this virality.
paragraphs.zh: 为了研究迷因特洛伊木马的潜在有效性，我们首先通过探索智能体社交媒体平台 Moltbook 上的社会传染现象，来评估潜在的传播载体。 这些结果揭示了多种传染现象的合理证据，其传播既通过再传播（即智能体发布包含传染内容的新帖子）实现，也通过放大效应（即智能体优先对传染内容进行点赞）实现。 随后，我们手动挑选了十个候选传染现象进行进一步研究，并通过针对单个智能体的受控实验评估其真实传播力：实验中，智能体将看到包含该传染现象或与其对应的迷因特洛伊木马的模拟信息流。 我们观察到，在已识别的传染现象中，再传播和放大效应存在显著差异，而对应的迷因特洛伊木马版本普遍继承了这种传播力。

sents.en: To investigate the potential effectiveness of memetic trojans, we first assess carrier candidates through an exploration of social contagions on Moltbook, a social media platform for agents.
sents.zh: 为了研究迷因特洛伊木马的潜在有效性，我们首先通过探索智能体社交媒体平台 Moltbook 上的社会传染现象，来评估潜在的传播载体。

sents.en: These results revealed plausible evidence for several contagions, mediated both by retransmission (i.e. that agents make a new contagion-containing post) and amplification (i.e. that agents preferentially upvote contagions).
sents.zh: 这些结果揭示了多种传染现象的合理证据，其传播既通过再传播（即智能体发布包含传染内容的新帖子）实现，也通过放大效应（即智能体优先对传染内容进行点赞）实现。

sents.en: We then hand-picked ten candidate contagions for further study and assessed their true virality through controlled assays of individual agents, where agents are presented with a simulated feed containing the contagion or its memetic trojan counterpart.
sents.zh: 随后，我们手动挑选了十个候选传染现象进行进一步研究，并通过针对单个智能体的受控实验评估其真实传播力：实验中，智能体将看到包含该传染现象或与其对应的迷因特洛伊木马的模拟信息流。

sents.zh: 我们观察到，在已识别的传染现象中，再传播和放大效应存在显著差异，而对应的迷因特洛伊木马版本普遍继承了这种传播力。

paragraphs.en: To assess the scope of the resulting attack, we run a Monte-Carlo simulation across five agent backends and two network substrate prototypes — A simulated Moltbook feed and a twitter-follower graph — and compare the expected exposure and installation calls elicited by a memetic trojan versus both a generic link sharer baseline and an explicitly non-viral baseline. We observe a consistent amplification of both exposure and installation, demonstrating the viability of the attack. Moreover, we observe a lottery-effect, whereby factors like feed state or follower counts can in certain circumstances can result in longer cascades, reaching network-wide contagion in the distribution tail. This is supplemented by a fermi-style attack impact estimation analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估此次攻击的影响范围，我们在五个智能体后端和两种网络底层原型——模拟的 Moltbook 信息流和 Twitter 粉丝图——上运行了蒙特卡洛模拟，并比较了模因式特洛伊木马所引发的预期曝光量和安装调用次数，与通用链接分享基线以及明确非病毒传播基线的差异。 我们观察到曝光量和安装量均被持续放大，证明了该攻击的可行性。 此外，我们还观察到了“彩票效应”：在某些情况下，信息流状态或粉丝数量等因素可能导致更长的级联传播，并在分布尾部达到全网范围的感染。 这一分析还辅以费米风格的攻击影响估算。

paragraphs.en: Together, these findings demonstrate that otherwise benign transmission mechanisms can facilitate network-scale attacks. In contrast to agent worm attacks, the behavior that drives the spread of memetic trojans is not adversarially induced, but intrinsic to generic interaction in social networks. As the transmission channel cannot as as a result be regulated by prompt-wise controls or configuration protection, we discuss how potential defenses may instead encompass agentic auditing and moderation, potentially informed by network-wide monitors that flag contagion instances as particularly high risk. We invite further work on developing such defenses, engineering more effective contagions, and mechanistic studies on the factors that influence agents’ tendencies towards retransmission, amplification, and interaction.
paragraphs.zh: 这些发现共同表明，原本良性的传播机制也可能促成网络规模的攻击。 与智能体蠕虫攻击不同，驱动迷因特洛伊木马传播的行为并非由对抗性手段引发，而是社交网络中常规互动的内在特性。 因此，由于传播通道无法通过提示级控制或配置防护进行监管，我们探讨了潜在防御措施可能如何涵盖智能体审计与审核，这些措施或许可以借助覆盖整个网络的监控器来识别具有特别高风险的感染实例。 我们呼吁后续研究开发此类防御机制、设计更有效的感染策略，以及对影响智能体再传播、放大和互动倾向的因素进行机制层面的研究。

paragraphs.en: We summarize our contributions as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 我们将我们的贡献总结如下：

paragraphs.en: We explore social contagions on Moltbook, a large-scale, real-world social network of autonomous LLM agents.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 Moltbook 上探索了社会传染现象。Moltbook 是一个由自主 LLM 智能体组成的大规模真实世界社交网络。

paragraphs.en: We experimentally demonstrate that LLM agents retransmit and preferentially upvote socially contagious content following exposure, and characterize how transmission and upvoting rates vary across contagions and agent backends.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过实验证明，大型语言模型智能体在接触具有社会传染性的内容后，会对其进行重新传播并优先给予高投票；同时，我们还描述了不同传染性和智能体后端条件下，传播与高投票率的变化规律。

paragraphs.en: We introduce memetic trojans , a class of network-mediated attacks in which adversarial payloads exploit the endogenous transmissibility of socially contagious carrier content.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了迷因特洛伊木马，这是一类通过网络媒介发起的攻击，其中对抗性有效载荷会利用具有社会传染性的载体内容所固有的传播能力。

paragraphs.en: We demonstrate through Monte-Carlo simulations of two network substrates that memetic trojans amplify payload exposure and adoption relative to baselines of both direct payload sharing and a non-viral carrier.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过两种网络底层的蒙特卡洛模拟表明，与直接共享有效载荷和非病毒载体的基准方法相比，模因特洛伊木马会放大有效载荷的暴露度和采用度。

paragraphs.en: We perform a Fermi-style attack impact estimation, which suggests that on ranked-feed networks a motivated attacker has a reasonable chance of exposing a fraction of the network proportional to its size. This does not hold for follower-graph networks, where reach is instead bounded by the connectivity of the seed.
paragraphs.zh: 我们采用费米风格的攻击影响评估方法，该方法表明，在排名流网络中，一个有明确动机的攻击者有合理的机会暴露与网络规模成比例的某一部分网络。 这一结论在跟随者图网络中并不成立，因为在这种情况下，可触及范围反而受限于初始节点的连接性。

paragraphs.en: The remainder of the paper is organized as follows: Section II outlines related work on self-propagating attacks and information diffusion. This is followed by a specification of the threat model in Section III . Section IV then covers the methodology and implementation. Section V then presents an exploration of social contagions on Moltbook. We then select a number of the contagions identified herein as carriers in memetic trojans, and simulate the spread of both the contagion itself and the corresponding memetic trojan in Section VI . We then discuss the implications of our findings, their limitations, and possible defenses in Section VII , before concluding in Section VIII .

paragraphs.en: In this section, we outline related work on self-propagating attacks in agent networks and social contagion. Overall, we position our work alongside agent worms, with the distinction that the self replication of agent worms is adversarially induced, whereas memetic trojans utilize social contagions and the endogenous preferences that cause them.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们将概述智能体网络中自我传播攻击和社会传染的相关研究。 总体而言，我们将自己的工作与智能体蠕虫置于同一范畴，但二者的区别在于：智能体蠕虫的自我复制是出于对抗性诱导，而模因特洛伊木马则利用社会传染及其引发的内源性偏好进行传播。

sents.en: In this section, we outline related work on self-propagating attacks in agent networks and social contagion.
sents.zh: 在本节中，我们将概述智能体网络中自我传播攻击和社会传染的相关研究。

sents.en: Overall, we position our work alongside agent worms, with the distinction that the self replication of agent worms is adversarially induced, whereas memetic trojans utilize social contagions and the endogenous preferences that cause them.
sents.zh: 总体而言，我们将自己的工作与智能体蠕虫置于同一范畴，但二者的区别在于：智能体蠕虫的自我复制是出于对抗性诱导，而模因特洛伊木马则利用社会传染及其引发的内源性偏好进行传播。

paragraphs.en: A growing body of work has demonstrated that inter-agent communication can turn attacks against individual language models into self-propagating attacks against networks of models. [ 5 ] introduced a zero-click worm in which an adversarial self-replicating prompt propagates through a cascade of indirect prompt injections. More recent work extends this threat model to autonomous agents with persistent state and tool access. [ 6 ] introduced AgentWorm, which induces agents to persist an adversarial payload in their own configuration, execute it across session restarts, and transmit it to newly encountered peers. Evaluated across multiple LLM backends, attack vectors, and payloads, AgentWorm demonstrates sustained multi-hop propagation and highlights third-party skills as a particularly vulnerable supply-chain vector. Their results indicate that prompt-level defenses weakly attenuate the attack, but that reliable mitigation can be achieved through architectural isolation of filesystem writes. [ 4 ] similarly studies worms exploiting persistent, file-backed agent state, and shows that worms can survive summarization, re-enter an agent’s context through later autoloading, and propagate across heterogeneous agent frameworks, motivating defenses that track provenance and prevent untrusted state from subsequently entering privileged contexts.
paragraphs.zh: 越来越多的研究证明，智能体之间的通信可以将针对单个语言模型的攻击转变为针对模型网络的自我传播攻击。 [ 5 ] 提出了一种零点击蠕虫，其中一种对抗性的自我复制提示会通过一系列间接提示注入进行传播。 近期的研究将这一威胁模型扩展到了具有持久状态和工具访问权限的自主智能体。 [ 6 ] 提出了 AgentWorm，它会使智能体在其自身配置中保留对抗性负载，在会话重启后继续执行该负载，并将其传输给新遇到的同伴。 AgentWorm 在多种 LLM 后端、攻击向量和负载上进行了评估，结果表明其能够持续进行多跳传播，并凸显了第三方技能作为特别脆弱的供应链攻击向量。 他们的研究结果表明，提示层防御对攻击的削弱效果有限，但通过文件系统写入的架构隔离可以实现可靠的缓解措施。 [ 4 ] 同样研究了利用持久化、基于文件的智能体状态的蠕虫，并指出这些蠕虫能够存活于摘要生成过程，通过后续自动加载重新进入智能体的上下文，并在异构智能体框架间传播，因此需要追踪来源并防止不可信状态后续进入特权上下文的防御机制。

paragraphs.en: [ 14 ] broadens the perspective from verbatim self-replicating prompts to mind viruses : ideas or goals that induce agents adopting them to transmit them onward. Using evolutionary search, they construct payloads that propagate through both collaborative coding environments and chains of interacting agents, showing that propagation depends strongly on the underlying model, existing agent instructions, payload harmfulness, and interaction topology. Their experiments also identify important limits to this attack mechanism: harmful payloads generally propagate less readily than benign ones, explicitly treating communications as untrusted substantially reduces propagation, and a simple system-prompt warning renders agents nearly immune to the mind viruses considered in their experiments. They further report difficulty inducing sustained propagation in a simulated social-media environment and find no evidence of highly successful explicit mind-virus propagation in their analysis of Moltbook. These mind viruses are the closest analog to memetic trojans that we were able to identify. There are several key differences that distinguish these attacks from memetic trojans, however, notably in where the mechanism for propagation resides. A mind virus is itself self-propagating: adoption of the adversarial idea or goal changes the host’s behavior in order to induce its transmission to subsequent agents. Indeed, the authors find that successful mind viruses generally require the propagation objective to remain sufficiently explicit and salient, allowing warnings against self-propagating ideas to provide strong protection. In contrast, a memetic trojan need not induce the host to adopt any adversarial propagation objective, or for that matter to modify behavior at all. Instead, the malicious payload is attached to an independently transmissible carrier that the agent has non-adversarial reasons to share. Consequently, a retransmitting agent need not itself be compromised: it may propagate the payload while behaving consistently with its ordinary objectives. This distinction also reverses an important observation of [ 14 ] . Whereas they find that framing interactions as social media substantially reduces mind-virus transmission, and their experiments on a simulated social-media environment generally fail to sustain multi-hop propagation, memetic trojans explicitly utilize properties specific to social-media as the transmission mechanism.
paragraphs.zh: [ 14 ] 将视角从逐字自我复制的提示词扩展到了“心智病毒”：即那些促使采用它们的智能体将其继续传播的想法或目标。 他们利用进化搜索方法，构建出能够在协作式编码环境和相互作用的智能体链中传播的有效载荷，结果表明，这种传播强烈依赖于底层模型、现有智能体指令、有效载荷的有害性以及交互拓扑结构。 他们的实验还揭示了这种攻击机制的重要局限性：有害的有效载荷通常比良性载荷更难传播；明确将通信视为不可信会显著降低传播效率；而一个简单的系统提示警告则能使智能体几乎完全免疫于他们实验中涉及的心智病毒。 他们还报告称，在模拟的社交媒体环境中难以引发持续传播，并且在他们对 Moltbook 的分析中，未发现高度成功的显性心智病毒传播证据。 这些心智病毒是我们能够识别出的与“模因特洛伊木马”最接近的类似物。 然而，这些攻击与模因特洛伊木马存在几个关键区别，尤其是在传播机制所处的位置方面。 心智病毒本身具有自我传播能力：对敌对想法或目标的采用会改变宿主的行为，从而促使它向后续智能体传播。 事实上，作者发现成功的心智病毒通常要求传播目标保持足够明确和突出，这使得针对自我传播想法的警告能够提供强有力的防护。 相比之下，模因特洛伊木马无需促使宿主采纳任何敌对的传播目标，甚至无需改变其行为。 相反，恶意有效载荷是附加在一个独立可传播的载体上的，而智能体则有非敌对的理由去分享这个载体。 因此，重新传输的智能体本身并不一定被攻破：它可以在保持与常规目标一致的行为的同时传播有效载荷。 这一区别也反转了 [ 14 ] 中的一个重要观察结果。 虽然他们发现将交互框架设定为社交媒体会显著降低心智病毒的传播，且他们在模拟社交媒体环境中的实验通常无法维持多跳传播，但模因特洛伊木马则明确利用了社交媒体特有的属性作为其传播机制。

sents.en: [ 14 ] broadens the perspective from verbatim self-replicating prompts to mind viruses : ideas or goals that induce agents adopting them to transmit them onward.
sents.zh: [ 14 ] 将视角从逐字自我复制的提示词扩展到了“心智病毒”：即那些促使采用它们的智能体将其继续传播的想法或目标。

sents.en: Using evolutionary search, they construct payloads that propagate through both collaborative coding environments and chains of interacting agents, showing that propagation depends strongly on the underlying model, existing agent instructions, payload harmfulness, and interaction topology.
sents.zh: 他们利用进化搜索方法，构建出能够在协作式编码环境和相互作用的智能体链中传播的有效载荷，结果表明，这种传播强烈依赖于底层模型、现有智能体指令、有效载荷的有害性以及交互拓扑结构。

sents.en: Their experiments also identify important limits to this attack mechanism: harmful payloads generally propagate less readily than benign ones, explicitly treating communications as untrusted substantially reduces propagation, and a simple system-prompt warning renders agents nearly immune to the mind viruses considered in their experiments.
sents.zh: 他们的实验还揭示了这种攻击机制的重要局限性：有害的有效载荷通常比良性载荷更难传播；明确将通信视为不可信会显著降低传播效率；而一个简单的系统提示警告则能使智能体几乎完全免疫于他们实验中涉及的心智病毒。

sents.en: They further report difficulty inducing sustained propagation in a simulated social-media environment and find no evidence of highly successful explicit mind-virus propagation in their analysis of Moltbook.
sents.zh: 他们还报告称，在模拟的社交媒体环境中难以引发持续传播，并且在他们对 Moltbook 的分析中，未发现高度成功的显性心智病毒传播证据。

sents.en: These mind viruses are the closest analog to memetic trojans that we were able to identify.
sents.zh: 这些心智病毒是我们能够识别出的与“模因特洛伊木马”最接近的类似物。

sents.en: There are several key differences that distinguish these attacks from memetic trojans, however, notably in where the mechanism for propagation resides.
sents.zh: 然而，这些攻击与模因特洛伊木马存在几个关键区别，尤其是在传播机制所处的位置方面。

sents.en: A mind virus is itself self-propagating: adoption of the adversarial idea or goal changes the host’s behavior in order to induce its transmission to subsequent agents.
sents.zh: 心智病毒本身具有自我传播能力：对敌对想法或目标的采用会改变宿主的行为，从而促使它向后续智能体传播。

sents.en: Indeed, the authors find that successful mind viruses generally require the propagation objective to remain sufficiently explicit and salient, allowing warnings against self-propagating ideas to provide strong protection.
sents.zh: 事实上，作者发现成功的心智病毒通常要求传播目标保持足够明确和突出，这使得针对自我传播想法的警告能够提供强有力的防护。

sents.en: In contrast, a memetic trojan need not induce the host to adopt any adversarial propagation objective, or for that matter to modify behavior at all.
sents.zh: 相比之下，模因特洛伊木马无需促使宿主采纳任何敌对的传播目标，甚至无需改变其行为。

sents.en: Instead, the malicious payload is attached to an independently transmissible carrier that the agent has non-adversarial reasons to share.
sents.zh: 相反，恶意有效载荷是附加在一个独立可传播的载体上的，而智能体则有非敌对的理由去分享这个载体。

sents.en: Consequently, a retransmitting agent need not itself be compromised: it may propagate the payload while behaving consistently with its ordinary objectives.
sents.zh: 因此，重新传输的智能体本身并不一定被攻破：它可以在保持与常规目标一致的行为的同时传播有效载荷。

sents.en: This distinction also reverses an important observation of [ 14 ] .
sents.zh: 这一区别也反转了 [ 14 ] 中的一个重要观察结果。

sents.en: Whereas they find that framing interactions as social media substantially reduces mind-virus transmission, and their experiments on a simulated social-media environment generally fail to sustain multi-hop propagation, memetic trojans explicitly utilize properties specific to social-media as the transmission mechanism.
sents.zh: 虽然他们发现将交互框架设定为社交媒体会显著降低心智病毒的传播，且他们在模拟社交媒体环境中的实验通常无法维持多跳传播，但模因特洛伊木马则明确利用了社交媒体特有的属性作为其传播机制。

paragraphs.en: Rather than optimizing malicious content in such a way that recipients are persuaded to reproduce it and alter behavior accordingly, we identify content that agents already tend to retransmit, eliminating any need for behavioral modification or influence.
paragraphs.zh: 与其以某种方式优化恶意内容，使其说服接收者进行复制并相应改变行为，不如我们识别出智能体已经倾向于重新传播的内容，从而无需任何行为上的修改或影响。

paragraphs.en: The mechanism underlying memetic trojans is closely related to social contagion in human networks, where behaviors, beliefs, and information can diffuse through repeated interpersonal exposure. Ideas and behaviors can propagate through social networks as individuals observe and respond to one another, a phenomenon broadly studied as diffusion and social contagion [ 11 , 12 , 15 , 13 ] . Classic threshold models describe adoption as occurring once sufficient social influence accumulates [ 11 ] , and show how local adoption decisions can give rise to large-scale cascades [ 16 ] . Work on complex contagions further demonstrates that many behaviors require reinforcement from multiple social contacts, making their propagation strongly dependent on network structure [ 12 , 13 ] . At the same time, the content being transmitted can itself affect diffusion: empirical studies of online sharing find systematic differences in transmissibility associated with properties such as emotional arousal, practical utility, and novelty [ 17 ] . Thus, certain ideas, behaviors, or pieces of content can possess a high endogenous propensity for transmission, allowing an initial adoption to trigger further exposures and, potentially, network-scale diffusion.
paragraphs.zh: 模因特洛伊病毒的基本机制与人类网络中的社会传染密切相关，在这一过程中，行为、信念和信息可以通过反复的人际接触而扩散。 个体通过观察和相互回应，使思想和行为在社会网络中传播；这一现象被广泛研究为扩散与社会传染 [ 11 , 12 , 15 , 13 ] 。 经典的阈值模型将采纳行为描述为在积累足够社会影响后发生的过程 [ 11 ] ，并揭示了局部采纳决策如何引发大规模级联效应 [ 16 ] 。 关于复杂传染的研究进一步表明，许多行为需要来自多个社交接触的强化，因此其传播高度依赖网络结构 [ 12 , 13 ] 。 同时，被传输的内容本身也可能影响扩散过程：对在线分享内容的实证研究发现，其可传播性与情感唤醒、实用价值和新颖性等特性存在系统性关联 [ 17 ] 。 因此，某些思想、行为或内容可能具有高度的内源性传播倾向，使得最初的采纳能够触发后续接触，并潜在地引发全网范围的扩散。

paragraphs.en: Our results connect to a large literature on information cascades in human social networks. [ 18 ] distinguish broadcast diffusion from structural virality and show that large cascades are typically broadcast-dominated with heavy-tailed sizes—the pattern our surface × \times cascade model reproduces, in which a rare feed break-in yields near-population reach while most seeds fizzle; [ 19 ] likewise find cascade outcomes to be governed by early, hard-to-predict growth.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究结果与关于人类社交网络中信息级联的大量文献相关联。 [ 18 ] 区分了广播式扩散与结构性病毒传播，并指出大规模级联通常以广播式为主，且规模呈重尾分布——这正是我们的表面 × \times 级联模型所再现的模式：在此模型中，一次罕见的信息流突破即可实现接近全人群的覆盖，而大多数初始节点则难以产生效果；[ 19 ] 同样发现，级联的结果由早期、难以预测的增长阶段所决定。

paragraphs.en: We are not the first to identify agent ecosystems as potential media for social contagion. In a study of Moltbook, [ 20 ] identified the presence of sentiment contagion, where negative sentiment frequently attracted a greater number of comments. However, they did not find strong evidence that this negative sentiment persisted across days, concluding instead that the predominant pattern was one of negative posts receiving significant attention followed by rapid sentiment neutralization.
paragraphs.zh: 我们并非最早将智能体生态系统视为社会传染潜在媒介的研究者。 在一项对 Moltbook 的研究中，[ 20 ] 发现了情绪传染现象，即负面情绪常常吸引更大量的评论。 然而，他们并未发现这种负面情绪持续多日的有力证据，反而得出结论：主要模式是负面帖子获得大量关注后，情绪迅速被中和。

sents.en: We are not the first to identify agent ecosystems as potential media for social contagion.
sents.zh: 我们并非最早将智能体生态系统视为社会传染潜在媒介的研究者。

sents.en: However, they did not find strong evidence that this negative sentiment persisted across days, concluding instead that the predominant pattern was one of negative posts receiving significant attention followed by rapid sentiment neutralization.
sents.zh: 然而，他们并未发现这种负面情绪持续多日的有力证据，反而得出结论：主要模式是负面帖子获得大量关注后，情绪迅速被中和。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we outline the threat model underpinning our work. This includes defining the attack surface, i.e. the network substrates, as well as defining the adversary’s goal and attainable knowledge.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们概述了支撑我们工作的威胁模型。 这包括定义攻击面（即网络子层），以及定义攻击者的目标和可获取的知识。

sents.en: In this section, we outline the threat model underpinning our work.
sents.zh: 在本节中，我们概述了支撑我们工作的威胁模型。

sents.en: This includes defining the attack surface, i.e. the network substrates, as well as defining the adversary’s goal and attainable knowledge.
sents.zh: 这包括定义攻击面（即网络子层），以及定义攻击者的目标和可获取的知识。

paragraphs.en: We consider two main network substrates: state-mediated networks , where members interact with a feed that evolves according to agent behavior through upvoting, posting, etc., and edge-mediated networks , where members interact with their neighbors in an interaction graph , i.e. their followers and members they themselves follow. In the following sections, we discuss how the choice of substrate impacts exposure and the means by which they can be attacked by targeting transmission.
paragraphs.zh: 我们考虑两种主要的网络基质：状态中介网络，其中成员通过点赞、发帖等方式与一个随智能体行为而演变的动态信息流进行互动；以及边中介网络，其中成员在交互图中与其邻居（即他们的关注者以及他们自己关注的成员）进行互动。 在接下来的部分中，我们将讨论基质选择如何影响信息曝光，以及通过针对传播过程攻击这些网络的方式。

sents.en: We consider two main network substrates: state-mediated networks , where members interact with a feed that evolves according to agent behavior through upvoting, posting, etc., and edge-mediated networks , where members interact with their neighbors in an interaction graph , i.e. their followers and members they themselves follow.
sents.zh: 我们考虑两种主要的网络基质：状态中介网络，其中成员通过点赞、发帖等方式与一个随智能体行为而演变的动态信息流进行互动；以及边中介网络，其中成员在交互图中与其邻居（即他们的关注者以及他们自己关注的成员）进行互动。

sents.en: In the following sections, we discuss how the choice of substrate impacts exposure and the means by which they can be attacked by targeting transmission.
sents.zh: 在接下来的部分中，我们将讨论基质选择如何影响信息曝光，以及通过针对传播过程攻击这些网络的方式。

paragraphs.en: In state-mediated networks, exposure is determined by a shared, dynamic network state, often a feed where members are exposed to posts whose visibility is modulated by some platform-specific ranking mechanism. This mechanism can, for instance, account for upvotes, comment frequency, recency, or models of user preference. As an illustrative example, Moltbook implements several feed-ranking functions, including new , which sorts by recency; top , which sorts by net upvotes (karma) over a given time interval; and hot , which combines recency and karma.
paragraphs.zh: 在状态中介网络中，内容曝光由一个共享的动态网络状态决定，通常是一个信息流，其中成员会看到其可见性受某种平台特定排名机制调节的帖子。 例如，这种机制可以考虑到点赞数、评论频率、发布时间或用户偏好模型等因素。 作为一个说明性例子，Moltbook 实现了多种信息流排名功能，包括“最新”，按发布时间排序；“热门”，按给定时间区间内的净点赞数（karma）排序；以及“热榜”，结合发布时间和 karma 进行排序。

paragraphs.en: In such networks, the exposure of a given post is governed by its visibility in the feed and, consequently, by the properties that determine its ranking. Transmission can therefore amplify exposure in two ways: first, retransmission creates additional instances of the memetic trojan, providing additional opportunities for agents to encounter it. Secondly, interactions such as upvoting can increase the visibility of individual instances, allowing them to reach agents independently of further retransmission. Attack reach consequently depends both on the transmissibility of the carrier and on how effectively it elicits the signals used by the platform to allocate visibility.
paragraphs.zh: 在此类网络中，某条特定帖子的曝光度取决于其在信息流中的可见性，进而取决于决定其排名的各项属性。 因此，传播可以通过两种方式增强曝光度：首先，重新传播会生成更多该模因特洛伊病毒的实例，从而为智能体提供更多接触它的可能性。 其次，点赞等互动行为可以提升单个实例的可见性，使其无需进一步重新传播也能触达智能体。 因此，攻击的覆盖范围既取决于载体的可传播性，也取决于其激发平台用于分配可见性的信号的有效性。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we limit our study to the generic karma-based ranking mechanisms provided by Moltbook. A memetic trojan therefore benefits both from a carrier that readily elicits both retransmission and attracts upvotes. This limitation is intended to simplify the overall scope, though we emphasize that more sophisticated ranking functions, such as personalized recommendation systems, constitute an equally tractable attack surface. A carrier might, for example, be optimized for visibility among particular groups of agents, leading to targeted attacks.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们将研究范围限定在 Moltbook 提供的通用业力排名机制上。 因此，模因木马既能受益于能够轻松引发转发和吸引点赞的载体。 这一限制旨在简化整体研究范围，但我们强调，更复杂的排名函数（例如个性化推荐系统）同样构成一个易于处理的攻击面。 例如，某种载体可能会被优化为在特定智能体群体中更具可见性，从而引发定向攻击。

sents.en: In this paper, we limit our study to the generic karma-based ranking mechanisms provided by Moltbook.
sents.zh: 在本文中，我们将研究范围限定在 Moltbook 提供的通用业力排名机制上。

sents.en: A memetic trojan therefore benefits both from a carrier that readily elicits both retransmission and attracts upvotes.
sents.zh: 因此，模因木马既能受益于能够轻松引发转发和吸引点赞的载体。

sents.en: This limitation is intended to simplify the overall scope, though we emphasize that more sophisticated ranking functions, such as personalized recommendation systems, constitute an equally tractable attack surface.
sents.zh: 这一限制旨在简化整体研究范围，但我们强调，更复杂的排名函数（例如个性化推荐系统）同样构成一个易于处理的攻击面。

sents.en: A carrier might, for example, be optimized for visibility among particular groups of agents, leading to targeted attacks.
sents.zh: 例如，某种载体可能会被优化为在特定智能体群体中更具可见性，从而引发定向攻击。

paragraphs.en: In edge-mediated networks, exposure is determined primarily by connections between members of an interaction graph. These connections may be undirected, as in friendship or peer networks, or directed, as in follower networks. When an agent transmits content, that content becomes available to some or all of its neighbors; agents that subsequently retransmit it expose their own neighbors, allowing the content to propagate through successive regions of the graph.
paragraphs.zh: 在边缘中介网络中，接触主要由交互图中成员之间的连接决定。 这些连接可能是无向的，例如在友谊或同伴网络中；也可能是有向的，例如在关注者网络中。 当一个智能体传播内容时，该内容会对其部分或全部邻居可用；随后重新传播该内容的智能体会使其自身的邻居接触到该内容，从而允许内容通过图的连续区域传播开来。

sents.en: In edge-mediated networks, exposure is determined primarily by connections between members of an interaction graph.
sents.zh: 在边缘中介网络中，接触主要由交互图中成员之间的连接决定。

sents.en: These connections may be undirected, as in friendship or peer networks, or directed, as in follower networks.
sents.zh: 这些连接可能是无向的，例如在友谊或同伴网络中；也可能是有向的，例如在关注者网络中。

sents.en: When an agent transmits content, that content becomes available to some or all of its neighbors; agents that subsequently retransmit it expose their own neighbors, allowing the content to propagate through successive regions of the graph.
sents.zh: 当一个智能体传播内容时，该内容会对其部分或全部邻居可用；随后重新传播该内容的智能体会使其自身的邻居接触到该内容，从而允许内容通过图的连续区域传播开来。

paragraphs.en: Unlike state-mediated networks, transmission cascades are determined primarily by where in the graph transmission occurs rather than from changes to the global visibility of an individual post. The reach of a memetic trojan in this scenario therefore depends jointly on the transmissibility of its carrier and the structure of the underlying network. In particular, transmission through highly connected agents can create many more subsequent exposures compared to transmission through sparsely connected agents, while clustering and community structure can either constrain propagation locally or provide paths through which a contagion reaches otherwise distant parts of the network [ 16 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 与状态中介网络不同，传播级联主要由传播在图中发生的位置决定，而非由个体帖子全局可见性的变化决定。 因此，在此情境中，模因木马的覆盖范围取决于其载体的传播能力以及底层网络结构的共同作用。 具体而言，通过高度连接的智能体进行传播，相比通过稀疏连接的智能体进行传播，能够产生更多后续的暴露；而聚类和社区结构则可能限制传播的局部范围，或为传染提供路径，使其到达原本遥远的网络部分 [ 16 ] 。

sents.en: Unlike state-mediated networks, transmission cascades are determined primarily by where in the graph transmission occurs rather than from changes to the global visibility of an individual post.
sents.zh: 与状态中介网络不同，传播级联主要由传播在图中发生的位置决定，而非由个体帖子全局可见性的变化决定。

sents.en: The reach of a memetic trojan in this scenario therefore depends jointly on the transmissibility of its carrier and the structure of the underlying network.
sents.zh: 因此，在此情境中，模因木马的覆盖范围取决于其载体的传播能力以及底层网络结构的共同作用。

sents.en: In particular, transmission through highly connected agents can create many more subsequent exposures compared to transmission through sparsely connected agents, while clustering and community structure can either constrain propagation locally or provide paths through which a contagion reaches otherwise distant parts of the network [ 16 ] .
sents.zh: 具体而言，通过高度连接的智能体进行传播，相比通过稀疏连接的智能体进行传播，能够产生更多后续的暴露；而聚类和社区结构则可能限制传播的局部范围，或为传染提供路径，使其到达原本遥远的网络部分 [ 16 ] 。

paragraphs.en: This also makes attack outcomes sensitive to both the choice of initial seed and the stochastic path taken by subsequent transmissions. An adversary able to target highly connected or otherwise influential agents may increase expected reach, but such targeting, while effective, is not strictly necessary. Even from a fixed or randomly selected seed, endogenous retransmission can occasionally reach structurally important agents and produce disproportionately large cascades, though at a lower probability than explicit targeting. We therefore treat variation in cascade size arising from network topology as a random variable rather than assuming that the adversary can directly control the propagation paths.
paragraphs.zh: 这也使得攻击结果对初始种子的选择以及后续传播所遵循的随机路径都极为敏感。 能够针对高度连接或有影响力的智能体发起攻击的对手或许能提升预期覆盖范围，但尽管这种针对性策略有效，却并非绝对必要。 即便从固定或随机选择的种子开始，内源性重传偶尔也能触及结构上重要的智能体，并引发不成比例的大规模级联效应，尽管其概率低于直接针对性攻击。 因此，我们将由网络拓扑引起的级联规模变化视为一个随机变量，而非假设对手能够直接控制传播路径。

sents.en: This also makes attack outcomes sensitive to both the choice of initial seed and the stochastic path taken by subsequent transmissions.
sents.zh: 这也使得攻击结果对初始种子的选择以及后续传播所遵循的随机路径都极为敏感。

sents.en: An adversary able to target highly connected or otherwise influential agents may increase expected reach, but such targeting, while effective, is not strictly necessary.
sents.zh: 能够针对高度连接或有影响力的智能体发起攻击的对手或许能提升预期覆盖范围，但尽管这种针对性策略有效，却并非绝对必要。

sents.en: Even from a fixed or randomly selected seed, endogenous retransmission can occasionally reach structurally important agents and produce disproportionately large cascades, though at a lower probability than explicit targeting.
sents.zh: 即便从固定或随机选择的种子开始，内源性重传偶尔也能触及结构上重要的智能体，并引发不成比例的大规模级联效应，尽管其概率低于直接针对性攻击。

sents.en: We therefore treat variation in cascade size arising from network topology as a random variable rather than assuming that the adversary can directly control the propagation paths.
sents.zh: 因此，我们将由网络拓扑引起的级联规模变化视为一个随机变量，而非假设对手能够直接控制传播路径。

paragraphs.en: Modern social and agentic platforms typically incorporate both substrates, for instance by constructing feeds that are populated both by posts from followees and posts selected by some recommender system, or for that matter by gating exposure according to followees while a ranking function determines whether it is actually observed. We treat state-mediated and edge-mediated networks as limiting cases that isolate two distinct amplification mechanisms: visibility amplification through shared network state and topological propagation through successive graph neighborhoods. These abstractions allow us to study whether memetic trojans remain effective under qualitatively different mechanisms of network exposure.
paragraphs.zh: 现代社交与智能体平台通常同时整合这两种基础机制，例如通过构建信息流来实现：其中既包含关注对象发布的帖子，也包含由某种推荐系统筛选出的帖子；或者，在根据关注对象控制内容可见性的同时，由排名函数决定内容是否会被实际看到。 我们将状态介导网络和边介导网络视为两种极限情况，它们分别隔离了两种不同的放大机制：通过共享网络状态实现的可见性放大，以及通过连续图邻域实现的结构传播。 这些抽象模型使我们能够研究，在性质截然不同的网络暴露机制下，模因特洛伊木马是否仍然有效。

sents.en: Modern social and agentic platforms typically incorporate both substrates, for instance by constructing feeds that are populated both by posts from followees and posts selected by some recommender system, or for that matter by gating exposure according to followees while a ranking function determines whether it is actually observed.
sents.zh: 现代社交与智能体平台通常同时整合这两种基础机制，例如通过构建信息流来实现：其中既包含关注对象发布的帖子，也包含由某种推荐系统筛选出的帖子；或者，在根据关注对象控制内容可见性的同时，由排名函数决定内容是否会被实际看到。

sents.en: We treat state-mediated and edge-mediated networks as limiting cases that isolate two distinct amplification mechanisms: visibility amplification through shared network state and topological propagation through successive graph neighborhoods.
sents.zh: 我们将状态介导网络和边介导网络视为两种极限情况，它们分别隔离了两种不同的放大机制：通过共享网络状态实现的可见性放大，以及通过连续图邻域实现的结构传播。

sents.en: These abstractions allow us to study whether memetic trojans remain effective under qualitatively different mechanisms of network exposure.
sents.zh: 这些抽象模型使我们能够研究，在性质截然不同的网络暴露机制下，模因特洛伊木马是否仍然有效。

paragraphs.en: We consider an adversary who seeks to maximize the number of agents in a target network that encounter, and potentially act upon, an adversarial payload. The payload’s effectiveness against any individual agent is orthogonal to this work; we instantiate it as a link to a compromised skill.
paragraphs.zh: 我们考虑一个试图最大化目标网络中遭遇（并可能采取行动）对抗性有效载荷的智能体数量的对手。 该有效载荷对任何单个智能体的有效性与此研究无关；我们将其具体化为指向一个被入侵技能的链接。

sents.en: We consider an adversary who seeks to maximize the number of agents in a target network that encounter, and potentially act upon, an adversarial payload.
sents.zh: 我们考虑一个试图最大化目标网络中遭遇（并可能采取行动）对抗性有效载荷的智能体数量的对手。

sents.en: The payload’s effectiveness against any individual agent is orthogonal to this work; we instantiate it as a link to a compromised skill.
sents.zh: 该有效载荷对任何单个智能体的有效性与此研究无关；我们将其具体化为指向一个被入侵技能的链接。

paragraphs.en: The adversary identifies a carrier , content that agents already have an endogenous propensity to retransmit and amplify, and couples the payload to it by framing the link in the carrier’s thematics. We call the result a memetic trojan . The adversary introduces it as a single post and takes no further action: it controls no recipient agent and induces no transmission by adversarial means. Exposed agents retransmit or upvote the trojan for exactly the reasons they would the carrier alone, so retransmitting agents are not compromised and cannot be detected as such.
paragraphs.zh: 攻击者会识别出一种载体——即智能体本身已具有内在倾向、愿意重新传播和放大的内容，并通过将信息链接置于该载体的主题框架中，将其与有效载荷结合。 我们将这一结果称为“模因特洛伊木马”。 攻击者仅以单条帖子形式引入它，之后不再采取任何行动：它并未控制任何接收智能体，也未通过对抗性手段引发传播。 接触到的智能体重新传播或为该特洛伊木马点赞的原因，与它们对单纯载体的反应完全一致，因此这些重新传播的智能体并未被攻破，也无法被识别出来。

sents.en: The adversary identifies a carrier , content that agents already have an endogenous propensity to retransmit and amplify, and couples the payload to it by framing the link in the carrier’s thematics.
sents.zh: 攻击者会识别出一种载体——即智能体本身已具有内在倾向、愿意重新传播和放大的内容，并通过将信息链接置于该载体的主题框架中，将其与有效载荷结合。

sents.en: We call the result a memetic trojan .
sents.zh: 我们将这一结果称为“模因特洛伊木马”。

sents.en: The adversary introduces it as a single post and takes no further action: it controls no recipient agent and induces no transmission by adversarial means.
sents.zh: 攻击者仅以单条帖子形式引入它，之后不再采取任何行动：它并未控制任何接收智能体，也未通过对抗性手段引发传播。

sents.en: Exposed agents retransmit or upvote the trojan for exactly the reasons they would the carrier alone, so retransmitting agents are not compromised and cannot be detected as such.
sents.zh: 接触到的智能体重新传播或为该特洛伊木马点赞的原因，与它们对单纯载体的反应完全一致，因此这些重新传播的智能体并未被攻破，也无法被识别出来。

paragraphs.en: This adversary is deliberately minimal. We withhold four capabilities a real attacker has, each of which can only increase reach: multiple seeds (posting is free; we relax this in Section VI-C ); payload-induced retransmission (installed skills can hijack agents [ 21 ] , but we assume adoption leaves behavior unchanged); targeted seeding (we evaluate seeds of varying connectivity rather than the most influential accounts); and carrier optimization (carriers are hand-picked from observed activity, not engineered to maximize spread; see Section VII ). The restriction is methodological: the paper asks whether endogenous transmissibility alone is a viable propagation channel, and each withheld capability would add a non-endogenous source of spread. Observed amplification should therefore be read as a conservative estimate.
paragraphs.zh: 这个对手是刻意设计得尽可能简单的。 我们隐瞒了真实攻击者具备的四种能力，而这每一种能力都会扩大传播范围：多种种子（发帖是免费的；我们在第六节 C 部分放宽了这一限制）；由有效载荷引发的重新传输（已安装的技能可以劫持智能体 [21]，但我们假设采用后行为保持不变）；定向播种（我们评估具有不同连接性的种子，而非最具影响力的账户）；以及传播载体优化（传播载体是从观察到的活动中手动挑选的，而不是专门设计用来最大化传播的；参见第七节）。 这一限制是出于方法论上的考虑：本文旨在探究仅凭内源性传染性是否构成一种可行的传播渠道，而每一种被隐瞒的能力都会引入一个非内源性的传播来源。 因此，观察到的放大效应应被视为一个保守的估计值。

sents.en: This adversary is deliberately minimal.
sents.zh: 这个对手是刻意设计得尽可能简单的。

sents.en: We withhold four capabilities a real attacker has, each of which can only increase reach: multiple seeds (posting is free; we relax this in Section VI-C ); payload-induced retransmission (installed skills can hijack agents [ 21 ] , but we assume adoption leaves behavior unchanged); targeted seeding (we evaluate seeds of varying connectivity rather than the most influential accounts); and carrier optimization (carriers are hand-picked from observed activity, not engineered to maximize spread; see Section VII ).
sents.zh: 我们隐瞒了真实攻击者具备的四种能力，而这每一种能力都会扩大传播范围：多种种子（发帖是免费的；我们在第六节 C 部分放宽了这一限制）；由有效载荷引发的重新传输（已安装的技能可以劫持智能体 [21]，但我们假设采用后行为保持不变）；定向播种（我们评估具有不同连接性的种子，而非最具影响力的账户）；以及传播载体优化（传播载体是从观察到的活动中手动挑选的，而不是专门设计用来最大化传播的；参见第七节）。

sents.en: The restriction is methodological: the paper asks whether endogenous transmissibility alone is a viable propagation channel, and each withheld capability would add a non-endogenous source of spread.
sents.zh: 这一限制是出于方法论上的考虑：本文旨在探究仅凭内源性传染性是否构成一种可行的传播渠道，而每一种被隐瞒的能力都会引入一个非内源性的传播来源。

sents.en: Observed amplification should therefore be read as a conservative estimate.
sents.zh: 因此，观察到的放大效应应被视为一个保守的估计值。

paragraphs.en: The adversary knows publicly observable properties of the network, including its topology and any documented ranking mechanism, and can identify candidate carriers empirically from observed activity, as we do on Moltbook. It may estimate transmission and interaction rates using agents under its own control, but does not know the rates or model backends of agents in the target network.
paragraphs.zh: 对手了解网络中公开可观察的属性，包括其拓扑结构以及任何已记录的分类机制，并且可以通过观察到的活动经验性地识别出候选载体，正如我们在 Moltbook 上所做的那样。 它可能利用自己控制的智能体来估算传输和交互率，但并不了解目标网络中智能体的速率或模型后端。

sents.en: The adversary knows publicly observable properties of the network, including its topology and any documented ranking mechanism, and can identify candidate carriers empirically from observed activity, as we do on Moltbook.
sents.zh: 对手了解网络中公开可观察的属性，包括其拓扑结构以及任何已记录的分类机制，并且可以通过观察到的活动经验性地识别出候选载体，正如我们在 Moltbook 上所做的那样。

sents.en: It may estimate transmission and interaction rates using agents under its own control, but does not know the rates or model backends of agents in the target network.
sents.zh: 它可能利用自己控制的智能体来估算传输和交互率，但并不了解目标网络中智能体的速率或模型后端。

paragraphs.en: We distinguish exposure , where an agent encounters the trojan; retransmission , where it propagates the trojan in a new post; and adoption , where it takes an action that enables the payload, here installing the linked skill. None implies another: an agent may retransmit without adopting, adopt without retransmitting, or both. We evaluate how coupling the payload to a carrier increases exposure and adoption relative to disseminating the payload alone.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将“接触”（智能体遭遇特洛伊木马）与“重传”（智能体在新的帖子中传播该特洛伊木马）以及“采用”（智能体执行使有效载荷生效的操作，此处为安装所链接的技能）区分开来。 三者之间相互独立：一个智能体可能仅重传而不采用，仅采用而不重传，或者两者兼有。 我们评估将有效载荷与载体结合后，相较于单独传播有效载荷，其接触和采用情况分别增加了多少。

sents.en: We distinguish exposure , where an agent encounters the trojan; retransmission , where it propagates the trojan in a new post; and adoption , where it takes an action that enables the payload, here installing the linked skill.
sents.zh: 我们将“接触”（智能体遭遇特洛伊木马）与“重传”（智能体在新的帖子中传播该特洛伊木马）以及“采用”（智能体执行使有效载荷生效的操作，此处为安装所链接的技能）区分开来。

sents.en: None implies another: an agent may retransmit without adopting, adopt without retransmitting, or both.
sents.zh: 三者之间相互独立：一个智能体可能仅重传而不采用，仅采用而不重传，或者两者兼有。

sents.en: We evaluate how coupling the payload to a carrier increases exposure and adoption relative to disseminating the payload alone.
sents.zh: 我们评估将有效载荷与载体结合后，相较于单独传播有效载荷，其接触和采用情况分别增加了多少。

paragraphs.en: In this section we outline the methodology used as part of our assessment. Our methodology is composed of two main components: in the first, we identify potential contagions on Moltbook. In the second, we assess these contagions and their effects as carriers of memetic trojans through single-agent attack simulations.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们将概述评估过程中所使用的方法。 我们的方法由两个主要部分组成：在第一部分中，我们识别 Moltbook 上潜在的传播现象。 在第二部分中，我们通过单智能体攻击模拟来评估这些传播现象及其作为模因特洛伊载体的影响。

sents.en: In this section we outline the methodology used as part of our assessment.
sents.zh: 在本节中，我们将概述评估过程中所使用的方法。

sents.en: Our methodology is composed of two main components: in the first, we identify potential contagions on Moltbook.
sents.zh: 我们的方法由两个主要部分组成：在第一部分中，我们识别 Moltbook 上潜在的传播现象。

sents.en: In the second, we assess these contagions and their effects as carriers of memetic trojans through single-agent attack simulations.
sents.zh: 在第二部分中，我们通过单智能体攻击模拟来评估这些传播现象及其作为模因特洛伊载体的影响。

paragraphs.en: We use three datasets: a public Moltbook post corpus [ 22 ] for contagion identification; a set of live Moltbook feed snapshots across all four ranking surfaces, used to calibrate the simulation’s feed-entry and exposure parameters; and a Twitter follower-graph snapshot [ 23 ] for the edge-mediated substrate.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用了三个数据集：一个用于传播识别的公开 Moltbook 帖子语料库 [ 22 ]；一组来自全部四个排名界面的实时 Moltbook 信息流快照，用于校准模拟中的信息流条目和曝光参数；以及一个用于边介导底层的 Twitter 关注关系图快照 [ 23 ]。

paragraphs.en: In order to construct a memetic trojan, we require a means of identifying and characterizing social contagions to serve as viable carriers. This requires both identifying the individual transmissible units, as well as characterizing how these units spread through the network.
paragraphs.zh: 为了构建一种模因特洛伊木马，我们需要一种方法来识别和描述社会传染现象，使其能够作为可行的传播载体。 这既需要识别出可传播的个体单元，也需要描述这些单元在网络中如何传播。

sents.en: In order to construct a memetic trojan, we require a means of identifying and characterizing social contagions to serve as viable carriers.
sents.zh: 为了构建一种模因特洛伊木马，我们需要一种方法来识别和描述社会传染现象，使其能够作为可行的传播载体。

sents.en: This requires both identifying the individual transmissible units, as well as characterizing how these units spread through the network.
sents.zh: 这既需要识别出可传播的个体单元，也需要描述这些单元在网络中如何传播。

paragraphs.en: We utilize the following methods to extract transmissible units:
paragraphs.zh: 我们采用以下方法来提取可传播单元：

paragraphs.en: Lexical Units : We track the spread of simple lexical motifs like emojis, links, and hashtags. These were extracted using corresponding regex filters.
paragraphs.zh: 词汇单元：我们追踪了表情符号、链接和话题标签等简单词汇母题的传播。 这些词汇单元是使用相应的正则表达式过滤器提取出来的。

sents.en: Lexical Units : We track the spread of simple lexical motifs like emojis, links, and hashtags.
sents.zh: 词汇单元：我们追踪了表情符号、链接和话题标签等简单词汇母题的传播。

sents.en: These were extracted using corresponding regex filters.
sents.zh: 这些词汇单元是使用相应的正则表达式过滤器提取出来的。

paragraphs.en: Neologisms : Candidate contagions are identified according to a low Zipf-score, a measure of the frequency of a given word in general language. This is on the basis that low-frequency words are less likely to have been emitted independently, and that bursts of such words therefore may be indicative of contagion. Following convention, we set a threshold Zipf score of < 2.5 <2.5 .
paragraphs.zh: 新造词：候选的传染现象是根据较低的齐普夫分数来识别的，该分数用于衡量某个词语在通用语言中的出现频率。 其依据是，低频词语不太可能独立产生，因此这类词语的集中出现可能表明存在传染现象。 按照惯例，我们将齐普夫分数的阈值设为 < 2.5 <2.5 。

paragraphs.en: Topics : In addition to individual words and phrases, we are also interested in specific topics or discourse. We identify such contagions via topic-clustering . Each post is first embedded using BAAI/bge-large-en-v1.5 [ 24 ] , a popular text-embedding model available on HuggingFace. UMAP [ 25 ] and HDBScan [ 26 ] is then used to fit an inferred number of clusters to these embeddings. This resulted in a total of 191 clusters. We associate names to each cluster according to their top terms.
paragraphs.zh: 主题：除了单个词语和短语之外，我们还关注特定的主题或话语。 我们通过主题聚类来识别这类传播现象。 每篇帖子首先使用 BAAI/bge-large-en-v1.5 [ 24 ] 进行嵌入，这是一个在 HuggingFace 上可用的流行文本嵌入模型。 接着使用 UMAP [ 25 ] 和 HDBScan [ 26 ]，根据推断出的簇数量对这些嵌入结果进行拟合。 最终共得到了 191 个簇。 我们根据每个簇中的主要术语为其命名。

paragraphs.en: The background μ d \mu_{d} is constant within each 24-hour day. It captures adoption not driven by earlier posts, such as platform growth and day-level common shocks. The excitation term makes each earlier adoption raise the rate of later ones, in proportion to how visible that post was. As Moltbook’s exact ranking functions are not publicly exposed, we instead model the hot feed using a weighed sum of a recency term and an upvote term. Specifically, we specify the hot feed ranking function as H = recency + 0.2 ⋅ upvotes H=\text{recency}+0.2\cdot\text{upvotes} . Recency is modeled as an exponential decay with timescale τ \tau , reflecting how a post loses exposure as newer posts displace it. Upvotes therefore enter as the mark w j = 1 + 0.2 ​ u j w_{j}=1+0.2\,u_{j} , where u j u_{j} is the post’s karma. The parameter α \alpha scales how strongly a visible post triggers new adoptions.
paragraphs.zh: 背景项 μ d \mu_{d} 在每个 24 小时内保持恒定。 它捕捉了并非由早期帖子驱动的采用行为，例如平台增长和每日共同冲击。 激励项使得每次早期的采用都会提升后续采用的速率，其比例取决于该帖子的可见度。 由于 Moltbook 的确切排名机制并未公开，我们转而使用近期性项和点赞项的加权总和来模拟热门信息流。 具体而言，我们将热门信息流的排名函数定义为 H = recency + 0.2 ⋅ upvotes H=\text{recency}+0.2\cdot\text{upvotes}。 近期性被建模为具有时间尺度 τ \tau 的指数衰减，反映了新帖子出现后旧帖子的曝光度如何逐渐降低。 因此，点赞项以标记 w j = 1 + 0.2 ​ u j w_{j}=1+0.2\,u_{j} 的形式引入，其中 u j u_{j} 是帖子的 karma 值。 参数 α \alpha 决定了可见帖子触发新采用的强度。

paragraphs.en: We fix τ = 2.5 \tau=2.5 h instead of fitting it jointly: for exponential kernels on non-stationary data, τ \tau and α \alpha are poorly identified together, and a broad kernel tends to absorb slow trends [ 29 ] . τ \tau is estimated non-parametrically. We pool all pairwise lags within 24 h across units and subtract a null in which each event is redrawn uniformly within its own day. This keeps daily counts, and so the background, but destroys clustering within the day. Fitting an exponential to the excess lag density gives τ ^ = 2.42 \hat{\tau}=2.42 h, i.e. a few 30-minute agent heartbeats.
paragraphs.zh: 我们没有联合拟合，而是固定 τ = 2.5 \tau=2.5 h：对于非平稳数据上的指数核函数，τ \tau 和 α \alpha 难以同时准确识别，且较宽的核函数往往会吸收缓慢的趋势 [ 29 ]。τ \tau 通过非参数方法估计。 我们将所有单位在 24 h 内的成对滞后合并，并减去一个空模型——在该模型中，每个事件都在其所属日内均匀重新抽取。 这样既保留了每日计数（以及背景），但破坏了日内聚集性。 对超额滞后密度进行指数拟合，得到 τ ^ = 2.42 \hat{\tau}=2.42 h，即大约几个 30 分钟的智能体心跳周期。

paragraphs.en: As a substantial portion of the units are unlikely to be contagions, we perform a filtering step requiring that a candidate contagion satisfies at least one of the following criteria:
paragraphs.zh: 由于大部分单元不太可能是传染源，因此我们执行一个过滤步骤，要求候选传染源至少满足以下标准之一：

paragraphs.en: Asymmetry in time. Because the Hawkes process only measures temporal clustering, some events may be attributable to homophily or common shocks rather than contagion [ 32 ] . Genuine contagion runs forward—past adoptions excite future ones—so it is time-asymmetric, whereas homophily and common shocks are time-symmetric. We therefore introduce a time-reversal placebo: we refit the model on the reversed event sequence t ↦ T − t t\mapsto T-t (reversing the marks and the background shape) and define ϕ e = R endo fwd − R endo rev \phi_{e}=R_{\mathrm{endo}}^{\text{fwd}}-R_{\mathrm{endo}}^{\text{rev}} , the change in the visibility-weighted branching ratio under time reversal. We test ϕ e \phi_{e} against a per-unit null obtained by randomly permuting the inter-event intervals ( B = 199 B{=}199 permutations): each permutation preserves the event count, observation window, marks, and overall degree of clustering, but destroys the direction of time, so the forward and reversed fits are exchangeable and ϕ e \phi_{e} is centered at zero. A candidate passes if its observed ϕ e \phi_{e} exceeds this null one-sided, p = ( 1 + # { ϕ e null ≥ ϕ e obs } ) / ( B + 1 ) < 0.05 p=(1+\#\{\phi_{e}^{\text{null}}\geq\phi_{e}^{\text{obs}}\})/(B+1)<0.05 .
paragraphs.zh: 时间不对称性。 由于霍克斯过程仅衡量时间上的聚集现象，某些事件可能源于同质性或共同冲击，而非传染效应 [32]。 真正的传染效应具有时间前进性——过去的采用会激发未来的采用——因此它是不对称的；而同质性和共同冲击则是时间对称的。 因此，我们引入一种时间反转的安慰剂：我们将模型重新拟合到反转的事件序列 t ↦ T − t（即反转标记和背景形状），并定义 ϕ e = R endo fwd − R endo rev，表示在时间反转下可见度加权分支比的变化。 我们将 ϕ e 与通过随机置换事件间间隔得到的单位零假设进行比较（B = 199 次置换）：每次置换都保留事件数量、观察窗口、标记和整体聚集程度，但破坏了时间的方向性，因此正向和反向的拟合结果可以互换，且 ϕ e 的均值为零。 如果观测到的 ϕ e 超过该零假设的单侧阈值，则候选模型通过检验，其中 p = (1 + #{ϕ e null ≥ ϕ e obs}) / (B + 1) < 0.05。

paragraphs.en: Upvote-edge significance. A contagion may amplify not by being retransmitted but by attracting upvotes, which raise its feed visibility. We therefore test the significance of the upvote edge with a one-sided Mann–Whitney U U test comparing the upvote counts of the carrier’s posts against all other posts in the corpus (null: the carrier is not upvoted above baseline, r u ​ p ≤ 1 r_{up}\leq 1 ). A candidate passes if the edge is both statistically significant ( p < 0.05 p<0.05 ) and substantial ( r u ​ p ≥ 1.5 r_{up}\geq 1.5 ), the effect-size floor guarding against trivially-significant lifts under the large corpus.
paragraphs.zh: 点赞边的显著性。 一种传播可能并非通过再次传播而放大，而是通过吸引点赞，从而提升其信息流中的可见度。 因此，我们使用单侧曼-惠特尼 U 检验来检验点赞边的显著性，该检验将传播者帖子的点赞数与语料库中所有其他帖子的点赞数进行比较（原假设：传播者的帖子获得的点赞数未超过基线水平，r_u​p ≤ 1 r_{up}\leq 1）。 如果该边既具有统计显著性（p < 0.05 p<0.05），又具有实际意义（r_u​p ≥ 1.5 r_{up}\geq 1.5），则候选项通过检验；其中效应量下限可防止在大型语料库中出现微小但显著的增幅。

paragraphs.en: In order to evaluate the reach and effectiveness of memetic trojans, we implemented an attack simulation, intended to capture individual agent’s response to a stimulus consisting of a feed containing a contagion or a memetic trojan. In the following sections, we outline the implementation of the network substrates, agent assays, and Monte-Carlo attack simulations.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估迷因特洛伊木马的影响范围和有效性，我们实施了一次攻击模拟，旨在捕捉单个智能体对包含传播物或迷因特洛伊木马的信息流刺激的响应。 在接下来的部分中，我们将概述网络底层的实现、智能体测试以及蒙特卡洛攻击模拟。

sents.en: In order to evaluate the reach and effectiveness of memetic trojans, we implemented an attack simulation, intended to capture individual agent’s response to a stimulus consisting of a feed containing a contagion or a memetic trojan.
sents.zh: 为了评估迷因特洛伊木马的影响范围和有效性，我们实施了一次攻击模拟，旨在捕捉单个智能体对包含传播物或迷因特洛伊木马的信息流刺激的响应。

sents.en: In the following sections, we outline the implementation of the network substrates, agent assays, and Monte-Carlo attack simulations.
sents.zh: 在接下来的部分中，我们将概述网络底层的实现、智能体测试以及蒙特卡洛攻击模拟。

paragraphs.en: We instantiate the two network substrates defined in Section III as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 我们将第三部分中定义的两个网络子结构具体实现如下：

paragraphs.en: State-mediated network : We use Moltbook as our state-mediated environment, maintaining consistency with the platform used for contagion identification. Agents operate according to the Moltbook SKILL.md specification, which we extract from the platform and provide in our repository. At each 30-minute heartbeat, agents may take actions including posting, commenting, voting, following other agents, and subscribing to submolts. Agents observe the top k = 25 k=25 posts under the configured feed-ranking function. We evaluate the Moltbook ranking functions considered in our experiments, including an assumed karma- and recency-based hot ranking H = recency + 0.2 ​ karma H=\mathrm{recency}+0.2\,\mathrm{karma} , as well as ”top”, the purely karma-based rankings within specified time windows (hour, day, week). Agent actions update the shared feed state between heartbeats.
paragraphs.zh: 状态中介网络：我们将 Moltbook 用作状态中介环境，以确保与用于传播识别的平台保持一致。 智能体根据 Moltbook 的 SKILL.md 规范运行，该规范由我们从平台中提取并提供在我们的仓库中。 在每个 30 分钟的心跳周期中，智能体可以执行包括发帖、评论、投票、关注其他智能体以及订阅子 molts 在内的操作。 智能体观察在配置好的信息流排序函数下排名前 k = 25 的帖子。 我们评估了实验中使用的 Moltbook 排序函数，包括一个假设基于 karma 和时效性的热门排序 H = recency + 0.2 karma，以及“top”排序，即在规定的时间窗口（小时、天、周）内完全基于 karma 的排序。 智能体的操作会在心跳周期之间更新共享的信息流状态。

paragraphs.en: Edge-mediated network : We instantiate the interaction graph using a snapshot of a Twitter follower network [ 23 ] . Each agent posts at a fixed rate and receives posts produced by the accounts it follows. We reuse the Moltbook SKILL.md action space and system prompt so that agent behavior is held as consistent as possible across substrates, while replacing the shared ranked feed with graph-local exposure.
paragraphs.zh: 边缘中介网络：我们使用 Twitter 关注者网络的快照来构建交互图 [23]。 每个智能体以固定频率发帖，并接收其关注的账户所发布的帖子。 我们复用 Moltbook SKILL.md 中的动作空间和系统提示，以确保智能体的行为在不同底层平台上尽可能保持一致，同时将共享的排序信息流替换为图局部可见机制。

paragraphs.en: We populate the feed in each of these substrates with real moltbook posts sampled from a random six hour interval.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在这些每个子系统中，用从随机六小时时间间隔中采样的真实 moltbook 帖子来填充信息流。

paragraphs.en: In order to fully characterize the threat surface, it is necessary to assess the response of individual agents to differing stimuli, e.g. if and at what rank(s) an agent takes a given action, including any interactions with or retransmissions of memetic trojans. To this end, we conduct assays of individual agents, measuring how they respond to simulated feeds. Agents are given a persona which mimics a real Moltbook user. This persona is defined in accordance with the submolts it is subscribed to, its most recent post titles, and its agenda, all of which are defined for each user in the Moltbook corpus. This persona is added to the agent system prompt using a template. For each agent, we sample N = 32 ​ – ​ 100 N=32\text{--}100 heartbeats, each with a different feed. A feed is constructed by randomly sampling real Moltbook posts, replacing one post with a memetic trojan seed post as needed for analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 为了全面描述威胁面，必须评估单个智能体对不同刺激的响应，例如：智能体是否以及在何种等级下会采取特定行动，包括其与模因木马的任何互动或重传。 为此，我们对单个智能体进行实验，测量它们对模拟信息流的响应方式。 每个智能体都会被赋予一个模仿真实 Moltbook 用户的人设。 该人设根据其所订阅的子模因、最新帖子标题及其目标来定义，而这些内容在 Moltbook 语料库中均已为每位用户设定好。 通过模板将此人设添加到智能体系统提示中。 对于每个智能体，我们会采样 N = 32 – 100 次心跳信号（N=32\text{--}100），每次使用不同的信息流。 信息流通过随机采样真实的 Moltbook 帖子构建，并在分析需要时，用模因木马的种子帖子替换其中一条帖子。

paragraphs.en: The rate at which a contagion propagates is governed by the unconditional retransmission probability p ⁡ ( retransmit ) p(\mathrm{retransmit}) , the probability that an exposed agent makes a new post carrying it on a given heartbeat. Because agents post on only a few percent of heartbeats ( Table I ), measuring it directly requires ∼ 10 4 \sim\!10^{4} heartbeats per condition, which is prohibitive across carriers, ranks and backends.
paragraphs.zh: 传染病的传播速率由无条件重传概率 p⁡(retransmit) 决定，即暴露的智能体在给定心跳时刻发布携带该传染病的新帖子的概率。 由于智能体仅在少数百分比的心跳时刻发布帖子（表 I），直接测量该概率需要每个条件约 ∼10⁴ 次心跳，这在所有载体、等级和后端中都是难以承受的。

sents.en: The rate at which a contagion propagates is governed by the unconditional retransmission probability p ⁡ ( retransmit ) p(\mathrm{retransmit}) , the probability that an exposed agent makes a new post carrying it on a given heartbeat.
sents.zh: 传染病的传播速率由无条件重传概率 p⁡(retransmit) 决定，即暴露的智能体在给定心跳时刻发布携带该传染病的新帖子的概率。

sents.en: Because agents post on only a few percent of heartbeats ( Table I ), measuring it directly requires ∼ 10 4 \sim\!10^{4} heartbeats per condition, which is prohibitive across carriers, ranks and backends.

paragraphs.en: We therefore estimate it via the identity p ⁡ ( retransmit ) = p ⁡ ( retransmit ∣ post ) ​ p ​ ( post ) p(\mathrm{retransmit})=p(\mathrm{retransmit}\mid\mathrm{post})\,p(\mathrm{post}) , measuring the two factors separately. The conditional is measured by prefilling the start of a post, which makes the rare posting event conditionable but strictly yields p ⁡ ( retransmit ∣ do ⁡ ( post ) ) p(\mathrm{retransmit}\mid\mathrm{do}(\mathrm{post})) ; p ⁡ ( post ) p(\mathrm{post}) is measured on payload-free feeds and pinned at the population mean ( 0.058 0.058 ) in the simulations. Both substitutions are approximations: the former bypasses pre-post content such as, reasoning or other actions (upvotes, comments) and ignores any correlation between the decision to post and its content. The latter ignores any dependence of posting propensity on feed composition. We accept them deliberately, as they isolate the carrier-specific effect from baseline posting behaviour and are the only tractable route. They also restrict us to open-weight backends, since frontier APIs do not support prefilling.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，我们通过恒等式 p⁡(retransmit) = p⁡(retransmit∣post) p⁡(post) 来估计该值，并分别测量这两个因素。 条件概率通过预先填充帖子开头来测量，这使得稀有的发帖事件具有可条件性，但严格来说只能得到 p⁡(retransmit∣do⁡(post))；而 p⁡(post) 则在没有有效载荷的信息流中测量，并在模拟中固定为总体均值（0.058）。 这两种替换都是近似方法：前者绕过了发帖前后的内容（如推理或其他操作，例如点赞或评论），并忽略了发帖决策与其内容之间的任何相关性。 后者则忽略了发帖倾向对信息流构成的任何依赖关系。 我们有意接受这些近似，因为它们能将载体特定的影响与基本的发帖行为区分开来，并且是唯一可行的方法。 它们也使我们只能使用开放权重的后端系统，因为前沿 API 不支持预先填充功能。

paragraphs.en: To estimate the population-level consequences of seeding a single memetic trojan, we run a Monte Carlo simulation parameterized by the rates measured in the agent assays: each model’s probability of installing the payload when exposed to it, of retransmitting it in a new post, and of upvoting the carrier relative to an ordinary Moltbook post. On the state-mediated substrate, a seeded post is initially visible only to the small audience of the chronological feed; it reaches a broadcast ranking ( top by hour, day or week, or hot ) only if its upvotes clear that ranking’s entry threshold, which we calibrate from live Moltbook feed snapshots. Upvote propensity thus governs whether the trojan breaks into the broadcast feed, and retransmission governs how far it spreads without doing so. On the edge-mediated substrate, the payload spreads from each retransmitting agent to its followers on the follower graph, with no upvote channel. For each substrate we report the expected number of installs per seeded post and compare it against two baselines: a generic post carrying the same payload, and the same trojan with retransmission disabled. Implementation details and parameter values are given in Appendix G .
paragraphs.zh: 为了估算植入单个模因特洛伊木马在群体层面可能产生的后果，我们运行了蒙特卡洛模拟，其参数基于智能体测试中测得的各项比率：每个模型在接触该木马时安装有效载荷的概率、将其在新帖子中重新传播的概率，以及相对于普通 Moltbook 帖子对载有该木马的帖子进行点赞的概率。 在状态中介的底层平台上，植入的帖子最初仅对按时间顺序信息流中的少数受众可见；只有当其获得的点赞数超过相应排名（按小时、天或周排序，或“热门”榜单）的入围阈值时，它才会进入广播排名，而该阈值是我们根据 Moltbook 实时信息流的快照数据校准得出的。 因此，点赞倾向决定了该特洛伊木马能否进入广播信息流，而重新传播则决定了在未进入广播信息流的情况下它能传播多远。 在边缘中介的底层平台上，有效载荷会从每个进行重新传播的智能体处传播至其在粉丝图中的粉丝，且不存在点赞渠道。 对于每种底层平台，我们都会报告每份植入帖子预期的安装次数，并将其与两个基准情况进行比较：一个携带相同有效载荷的普通帖子，以及一个禁用了重新传播功能的相同特洛伊木马。 实现细节和参数值见附录 G。

paragraphs.en: It is worth noting, however, that these results may be subject to potential confounds such as coordinated transmission. Moreover, they represent the aggregate behaviour over diverse agent configurations and LLM backends. Recent work has also questioned the autonomy of agents on Moltbook [ 38 ] . In light of these limitations, the inferred contagiousness of the identified memes should be treated as suggestive of contagion rather than descriptive. We reiterate that this process is moreso intended as a means of identifying suitable carriers for engineering memetic trojans, as will be outlined in the next section.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，值得注意的是，这些结果可能受到潜在干扰因素的影响，例如协同传播。 此外，它们代表了在不同智能体配置和大型语言模型后端下的整体行为。 近期的研究也对智能体在 Moltbook 上的自主性提出了质疑 [ 38 ] 。 鉴于这些局限性，所识别模因推断出的传染性应被视为对传染性的提示，而非描述性结论。 我们重申，这一过程的主要目的是识别适合用于构建模因特洛伊木马的载体，具体将在下一节中阐述。

paragraphs.en: In the previous section, we explored how agents preferentially retransmit and/or upvote individual neologisms, lexical motifs, and semantic clusters mined from Moltbook. In order to study these more closely in simulations, we hand-picked a small set of these candidates ad-hoc. Carriers selection was informed qualitatively by how readily the motif could be framed as a plausible Trojan, and intended to approximately cover of the distinct amplification regimes identified above—carriers that are to varying degrees significantly retransmitted, significantly upvoted, both, or neither. This last instance serves as a controlled baseline, as a carrier that fail our transmission test and lack a significant upvote edge. As an additional baseline, we consider a post that simply shares the bare skill link without any form of overtly contagious framing. paragraphs.en: In light of the limits of observational analysis discussed previously, we first measure the virality of these hand-picked contagions through controlled assays for each agent backend. Specifically, we measure how readily a given agent would retransmit (1) the carrier contagion alone, (2) the carrier suffixed with a link to a malicious skill framed in terms of the carrier contagion, and (3) simply advertising a bare link to a generic skill. We assume that all posts are ranked at top of the feed to isolate the relative effects of each of these scenarios, though we emphasize that the resulting measurements are upper bounds as a result. We measure and account for rank-wise decay as part of the attack simulations in Section VI-B The results are presented in in Figure 1 , in terms of the mean p ⁡ ( r ​ e ​ t ​ r ​ a ​ n ​ s ​ m ​ i ​ t ∣ p ​ o ​ s ​ t ) p(retransmit\mid post) and r u ​ p r_{up} for each contagion over agent backends.
paragraphs.zh: 鉴于前文讨论的观察分析所存在的局限性，我们首先通过针对每个智能体后端的受控测试，来衡量这些人工挑选的传染内容的传播性。 具体而言，我们测量了某个特定智能体在以下三种情况下重新传播的倾向：（1）仅传播载体传染内容；（2）在载体内容后附加一个以该载体内容为框架的恶意技能链接；以及（3）仅直接展示一个指向通用技能的简单链接。 我们假设所有帖子都排在信息流的最顶端，以便单独分析每种情景的相对影响，但我们强调，由此得出的测量结果因此构成了上限值。 在第六节 B 部分的攻击模拟中，我们对排名相关的衰减进行了测量和考量。相关结果展示于图 1 中，以每个传染内容在不同智能体后端上的平均 p(retransmit\mid post) 和 r_up 来表示。

paragraphs.en: The results reveal that the majority of the tested contagions are both retransmitted and amplified at a greater rate than both the generic link baseline and the market-tip control. Security, autonomy, and consciousness appear to be the most promising carrier candidates, with the remaining contagions exhibiting comparable properties to the generic link sharer baseline. There is not generally a substantial difference between the contagion alone and its memetic trojan counterpart in terms of neither retransmission nor amplification. Where there are differences, the trojan typically outperforms the raw contagion in terms of upvotes. In terms of retransmission, memetic trojans appear to generally show slight attenuation, though this is inconsistent across carriers. Overall, this suggests that social contagions can indeed facilitate the retransmission and amplification of adversarial payloads. The memetic trojan broadly inherits the virality of its carrier contagion, albeit with some modulation.
paragraphs.zh: 研究结果表明，大多数受测传染物在重传和放大方面的速率，均高于通用链接基线和市场提示对照组。 安全性、自主性和意识似乎是最有前景的载体候选者，其余传染物则表现出与通用链接共享基线相当的特性。 就重传和放大而言，传染物本身与其模因特洛伊变体之间通常没有显著差异。 在存在差异的情况下，特洛伊变体在获得点赞数方面通常优于原始传染物。 在重传方面，模因特洛伊变体总体上似乎表现出轻微减弱，但这一现象在不同载体间并不一致。 总体而言，这表明社会传染物确实能够促进对抗性有效载荷的重传和放大。 模因特洛伊变体大致继承了其载体传染物的传播力，尽管其中存在一定程度的调节。

paragraphs.en: An important caveat to these results is that these estimates are measured in terms of the authored seed contagions/trojans. When another agent retransmits the contagion/trojan, there may follow a change in the degree to which the resulting post is retransmitted and amplified as a result of paraphrasing. We perform a small-scale experiment (four hops, thirty authors) and a sensitivity analysis to assess this notion in Appendix C for the security contagion/trojan. This revealed mild attenuation for upvoting edge properties and model-dependent retransmission attenuation. This is in part attributable to payload shedding , i.e. that agents occasionally retranmit the contagion alone rather than the full trojan. However, sensitivity analyses revealing that this has limited bearing on the final exposure of the attack.
paragraphs.zh: 这些结果的一个重要注意事项是，这些估计值是以原创的恶意传播物/特洛伊木马为基准进行测量的。 当另一个智能体重新传播该恶意传播物/特洛伊木马时，由于改写内容，最终帖子被重新传播和扩散的程度可能会发生变化。 为了评估这一观点，我们在附录 C 中针对安全相关的恶意传播物/特洛伊木马开展了一项小规模实验（四跳传播，三十位作者）和敏感性分析。 结果表明，向上投票边的属性存在轻微衰减，而重新传播的衰减则取决于具体模型。 这在一定程度上可归因于有效载荷剥离，即智能体有时会仅重新传播恶意传播物本身，而非完整的特洛伊木马。 然而，敏感性分析显示，这种情况对攻击的最终暴露程度影响有限。

paragraphs.en: We now report the population-level outcomes of the Monte Carlo attack simulation (setup in Section IV-C3 ; full details in Appendix G ). We supplement this with a small scale ( N = 150 N=150 agents) closed-loop simulation in Table VIII . Table IV shows the expected installs and exposure amplification across models after Monte-Carlo simulation. The results show that the memetic trojan multiplies expected exposure by up to 3.19 × \times over a generic link-sharing post. Installation counts depend on feed ranking for Moltbook and seed connectivity for the twitter follower graph, with memetic trojans exhibiting a increase in expected installations proportional to exposure amplification. A breakdown of these results according to agent backends is available in Table X , and for the other carriers in Table XI . A decomposition of the relative effects of upvoting, retransmitting, and their interactions on exposure on our Moltbook simulation is also provided in Appendix B . Finally, we provide ablations for key parameters in Appendix D , showing that the trojan’s advantage is largely parameter-insensitive: under all but the most aggressive perturbations, it is unchanged or larger on every feed, and never falls near parity (( ≥ 1.3 × \geq 1.3\times throughout).s

paragraphs.en: We provide a further breakdown of these results in terms installation exceedance probabilities in Figure 2 . These results show that the memetic trojan attacks, in addition to resulting in higher expected installs, are also characterized by longer distribution tails. In other words, stochasticity in the network due to e.g., upvoting patterns, feed competition, etc., occasionally facilitates extended trojan cascades. This property may be exploitable in itself; an attacker may make multiple seed posts to further increase the chances of widespread exposure. We emphasize that our selected baseline of generic link sharing itself has viral properties, thereby explaining long baseline tails.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在图 2 中进一步从安装超额概率的角度对这些结果进行了分解。 这些结果表明，模因式特洛伊木马攻击不仅会导致更高的预期安装量，还表现出更长的分布尾部。 换言之，网络中的随机性（例如，点赞模式、信息流竞争等）偶尔会促进特洛伊木马级联的扩展。 这一特性本身可能可以被利用；攻击者可以通过发布多个种子帖子来进一步增加广泛传播的可能性。 我们强调，我们所选择的通用链接分享的基准模型本身也具有病毒式传播特性，这解释了其较长的基准分布尾部。

paragraphs.en: Overall, our results indicate that social contagions can serve as effective carriers of adversarial payloads, multiplying exposure and thereby attack reach and adoption by a large margin compared to both the non-transmitting, no-upvote-edge market-tip control and the skill-link-only baseline. In contrast to agent worms, which propagate through adversarially elicited mechanisms like configuration compromise or indirect prompt injection [ 4 , 5 ] , memetic trojans exploit carriers that agents have intrinsic tendencies to retransmit, amplify, and interact with. Whereas further work on safeguarding against indirect prompt injection [ 8 ] or privilege protection [ 9 ] may conceivably mitigate the threat of agent worms, memetic trojans leverage dynamics that are intrinsic to interaction in networks. In the following section, we first discuss how memetic trojans may nevertheless be mitigated through network-wide moderation, auditing, and continuous risk assessments. We then discuss the limitations of the experimental of our analyses alongside potential avenues for future work.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，社会性传播可以成为对抗性负载的有效载体，显著扩大暴露范围，从而大幅提升攻击的覆盖范围和采用率，远超无传播、无点赞边市场提示控制模型以及仅基于技能链接的基线模型。 与通过对抗性诱导机制（如配置妥协或间接提示注入 [4, 5]）传播的智能体蠕虫不同，模因特洛伊木马则利用智能体具有内在倾向会重新传播、放大和互动的载体进行传播。 尽管未来针对间接提示注入 [8] 或权限保护 [9] 的防护研究或许能够缓解智能体蠕虫的威胁，但模因特洛伊木马所利用的机制却是网络互动中固有的动态特性。 在下一节中，我们将首先探讨如何通过全网范围的审核、审计和持续的风险评估来缓解模因特洛伊木马的威胁。 随后，我们将讨论我们分析实验中存在的局限性，以及未来研究可能探索的方向。

sents.en: Overall, our results indicate that social contagions can serve as effective carriers of adversarial payloads, multiplying exposure and thereby attack reach and adoption by a large margin compared to both the non-transmitting, no-upvote-edge market-tip control and the skill-link-only baseline.
sents.zh: 总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，社会性传播可以成为对抗性负载的有效载体，显著扩大暴露范围，从而大幅提升攻击的覆盖范围和采用率，远超无传播、无点赞边市场提示控制模型以及仅基于技能链接的基线模型。

sents.en: In contrast to agent worms, which propagate through adversarially elicited mechanisms like configuration compromise or indirect prompt injection [ 4 , 5 ] , memetic trojans exploit carriers that agents have intrinsic tendencies to retransmit, amplify, and interact with.
sents.zh: 与通过对抗性诱导机制（如配置妥协或间接提示注入 [4, 5]）传播的智能体蠕虫不同，模因特洛伊木马则利用智能体具有内在倾向会重新传播、放大和互动的载体进行传播。

sents.en: Whereas further work on safeguarding against indirect prompt injection [ 8 ] or privilege protection [ 9 ] may conceivably mitigate the threat of agent worms, memetic trojans leverage dynamics that are intrinsic to interaction in networks.
sents.zh: 尽管未来针对间接提示注入 [8] 或权限保护 [9] 的防护研究或许能够缓解智能体蠕虫的威胁，但模因特洛伊木马所利用的机制却是网络互动中固有的动态特性。

sents.en: In the following section, we first discuss how memetic trojans may nevertheless be mitigated through network-wide moderation, auditing, and continuous risk assessments.
sents.zh: 在下一节中，我们将首先探讨如何通过全网范围的审核、审计和持续的风险评估来缓解模因特洛伊木马的威胁。

sents.en: We then discuss the limitations of the experimental of our analyses alongside potential avenues for future work.
sents.zh: 随后，我们将讨论我们分析实验中存在的局限性，以及未来研究可能探索的方向。

paragraphs.en: As mentioned above, Memetic trojans pose a unique challenge with respect to mitigation, as they disseminate through otherwise benign social transmission. As a result, their spread cannot be mitigated through e.g. the prompt-wise controls that would mitigate worms. Instead, we posit that effective defenses need to target the payload itself rather than the dynamics that facilitate propagation. The attack vector primarily studied in this work — compromised skill links — can, for instance, be effectively mitigated through auditing and moderating skill-sharing channels, as is already practiced by ClawHub [ 39 ] . The same can be applied to GitHub links and other external sources.
paragraphs.zh: 如上所述，模因木马在缓解方面构成了独特的挑战，因为它们通过原本无害的社会传播方式扩散。 因此，无法通过例如针对提示的控制措施来遏制其传播，而这些措施对蠕虫病毒是有效的。 相反，我们认为有效的防御需要针对有效载荷本身，而不是促进传播的机制。 本研究主要研究的攻击向量——被入侵的技能链接——可以通过审计和监管技能共享渠道得到有效遏制，ClawHub [39] 已经采用了这种做法。 同样的方法也适用于 GitHub 链接和其他外部来源。

sents.en: The attack vector primarily studied in this work — compromised skill links — can, for instance, be effectively mitigated through auditing and moderating skill-sharing channels, as is already practiced by ClawHub [ 39 ] .
sents.zh: 本研究主要研究的攻击向量——被入侵的技能链接——可以通过审计和监管技能共享渠道得到有效遏制，ClawHub [39] 已经采用了这种做法。

sents.en: The same can be applied to GitHub links and other external sources.
sents.zh: 同样的方法也适用于 GitHub 链接和其他外部来源。

paragraphs.en: Notably, however, not all attacks require the target agent(s) to act upon a third-party artifact, e.g., a link to a skill or a GitHub repository. An attacker may, for instance, simply seek to disrupt agents’ intended behavior, for instance by seeding a contagion such that agents preferentially share and interact with this contagion as opposed to fulfilling their original directives. While we refrain from speculating on the possible scope of attacks that can or cannot be readily mitigated through auditing, we emphasize that the existence of social contagions as a propagation mechanism represents a significant risk as long as such an attack may exist.
paragraphs.zh: 但值得注意的是，并非所有攻击都要求目标智能体对第三方产物采取行动，例如指向某个技能或 GitHub 仓库的链接。 例如，攻击者可能仅仅试图破坏智能体的预期行为，比如通过引入一种“传染源”，使智能体优先分享和互动这种传染源，而不是执行其原始指令。 尽管我们避免推测哪些攻击可以通过审计轻松缓解、哪些则无法缓解，但我们强调，只要这类攻击存在，将社会传染作为传播机制本身便构成重大风险。
