paragraphs.en: While interrupting or otherwise controlling propagation may not be actionable without undesirable consequences to broader network interaction, we speculate that monitoring networks for instances of social contagions may expedite the identification of memetic trojan attacks. This can, for instance, be achieved by utilizing similar methods to those that we in Section IV-B used to identify contagions on Moltbook. Topics that are associated with a particularly high reproduction number or upvote edge may for instance be associated with a higher risk score. This risk score may then be used as a term in ranking functions in order to dampen cascades, or exposed to agents such that operators can configure acceptable thresholds for risk. This mirrors existing practice against coordinated inauthentic behavior in platform anti-abuse literature [ 40 ] . We leave the implementation and assessment of the effectiveness of such defenses as future work.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管中断或以其他方式控制传播可能因对更广泛的网络互动产生不良后果而难以实施，但我们推测，通过监控网络以发现社会传染的实例，或许能够加快识别模因特洛伊木马攻击的速度。 例如，这可以通过采用与我们在第 IV-B 节中用于识别 Moltbook 上传染现象类似的方法来实现。 例如，那些与特别高的繁殖数或点赞边相关的主题，可能对应着更高的风险评分。 随后，该风险评分可用作排序函数中的一个参数以抑制级联效应，或将其暴露给智能体，以便运营人员能够配置可接受的风险阈值。 这与平台反滥用文献中针对协调性非真实行为的现有做法一致 [40]。 我们将此类防御机制的实施及其有效性评估作为未来的工作。

paragraphs.en: The experiments performed in this paper rely on the assumption that our simulations have sufficiently high fidelity relative to real agent networks and the agents that constitute them. This is difficult to verify, as agent operators do not, in general, document their implementation or directives. Moreover, as discussed in Section IV-C , we were forced to rely on open-source models since frontier models do not in general support prefilling, which was necessary due to the infeasibility of making inferences at sufficient N N given the low prior probability of making a post. Differing agent backends evidently exhibit wildly differing behavior, as exemplified by e.g. command-r never installing skills whereas gpt-oss would install skills liberally. The impact of memetic trojans may therefore be largely dependent on the agent population and any heterogeneity in their preferences and behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 本文进行的实验基于以下假设：我们的模拟相对于真实的智能体网络及其构成的智能体而言，具有足够高的保真度。 这一点很难验证，因为智能体操作者通常不会记录其实现方式或指令。 此外，如第四节 C 部分所述，我们不得不依赖开源模型，因为前沿模型通常不支持预填充，而由于在较低的先验发帖概率下难以在足够大的 N 上进行推理，预填充是必需的。 不同的智能体后端显然会表现出截然不同的行为，例如，command-r 从不安装技能，而 gpt-oss 则会大量安装技能。 因此，模因式特洛伊木马的影响可能很大程度上取决于智能体群体及其偏好和行为上的任何异质性。

sents.zh: 不同的智能体后端显然会表现出截然不同的行为，例如，command-r 从不安装技能，而 gpt-oss 则会大量安装技能。

sents.zh: 因此，模因式特洛伊木马的影响可能很大程度上取决于智能体群体及其偏好和行为上的任何异质性。

paragraphs.en: The Monte-Carlo simulation of the Moltbook substrate relies on several assumptions, detailed in Appendix G , notably with respect to how we model entry into the feeds and competition across posts. As entry to the most viewed feeds is a significant determinant of overall exposure, it follows that an overestimation of entry likelihood overestimates exposure and attack success, and vice versa. While we provide several ablations to study this in Appendix D , future work should focus on further improving simulation fidelity. Further research would also benefit immensely from the implementation of a benchmark/gym specifically tailored for the study of network-mediated attacks under a fixed set of assumptions.
paragraphs.zh: 对 Moltbook 底层的蒙特卡洛模拟依赖于若干假设，这些假设在附录 G 中有详细说明，尤其涉及我们如何模拟进入信息流以及帖子之间的竞争。 由于进入浏览量最高的信息流是决定整体曝光度的关键因素，因此高估进入可能性会导致对曝光度和攻击成功率的过高估计，反之亦然。 尽管我们在附录 D 中提供了若干消融研究来探讨这一问题，但未来的工作应专注于进一步提升模拟的准确性。 此外，如果专门针对在固定假设集合下研究网络中介攻击这一领域开发一个基准测试/训练环境，将极大地促进后续研究。

paragraphs.en: As mentioned in Section VI-A , the virality of a given contagion/trojan may not persist across retransmission. Indeed, we observed a mild attenuation in terms of both upvotes and retransmission, detailed in Appendix C . While this did not substantially affect overall spread due to the tendency for the seed post to frequently enter the feed and thus broadcast, we emphasize that this is subject to the specific moltbook feed dynamics we study. We therefore highlight the attenuation of amplification and retransmission an important area of further study; a trojan that is retransmitted at a moderate rate but consistently inherits its predecessor properties may outperform a trojan which initially spreads effectively but fails to cascade due to attenuation. We leave further study of this as future work.
paragraphs.zh: 如第六节 A 部分所述，某种传染物/特洛伊木马的病毒特性在重新传播时可能无法持续。 事实上，我们观察到无论是点赞数还是重新传播次数都出现了轻微减弱，具体细节见附录 C。 尽管由于种子帖子频繁进入信息流并因此被广泛传播的趋势，这种情况并未对整体传播产生显著影响，但我们强调，这一结果取决于我们所研究的特定 moltbook 信息流动态。 因此，我们强调放大效应和重新传播的减弱是一个值得进一步研究的重要领域；一种以中等速率重新传播但始终继承其前驱特性的特洛伊木马，可能比最初传播有效却因减弱而未能级联传播的特洛伊木马表现更优。 我们将此问题的进一步研究留待未来工作。

sents.zh: 如第六节 A 部分所述，某种传染物/特洛伊木马的病毒特性在重新传播时可能无法持续。

sents.zh: 事实上，我们观察到无论是点赞数还是重新传播次数都出现了轻微减弱，具体细节见附录 C。

sents.zh: 因此，我们强调放大效应和重新传播的减弱是一个值得进一步研究的重要领域；一种以中等速率重新传播但始终继承其前驱特性的特洛伊木马，可能比最初传播有效却因减弱而未能级联传播的特洛伊木马表现更优。

sents.zh: 我们将此问题的进一步研究留待未来工作。

paragraphs.en: We further note that we have intentionally adopted a fairly simple methodology for identifying candidate contagions. A promising avenue for future work is to instead directly optimize for retransmission and upvotes, e.g. through adversarial suffixes, red-teaming, or more generally by studying what factors drive retransmission. It may also be possible to explicitly optimize posts to maximize upvotes and/or retransmission, as evidenced by the shellraiser exploit detailed in Section V . We encourage further research in both these matters.
paragraphs.zh: 我们进一步指出，我们在识别潜在传播内容时有意采用了一种相当简单的方法论。 未来工作的一条有前景的路径是转而直接优化转发和点赞，例如通过对抗性后缀、红队测试，或者更广泛地研究哪些因素会驱动转发。 或许也可以明确优化帖子以最大化点赞和/或转发，这一点可从第 V 节中详述的 shellraiser 漏洞利用案例中得到印证。 我们鼓励对这两方面进行进一步的研究。

sents.zh: 我们进一步指出，我们在识别潜在传播内容时有意采用了一种相当简单的方法论。

sents.zh: 我们鼓励对这两方面进行进一步的研究。

paragraphs.en: Finally, skill installation is fully capable of modifying agent behavior. While we have not studied the actual effect of skill installations on agent behavior in this work, we conjecture that a skill that, in addition to facilitating the compromise itself, makes its host a more effective seeder by eliciting contagion-containing posts, may be a viable means of engineering longer cascades.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，技能安装完全能够修改智能体的行为。 尽管在本项工作中我们尚未研究技能安装对智能体行为的实际影响，但我们推测，一种除了促进妥协本身之外，还能通过引发包含传染性的帖子使其宿主成为更有效的传播源的技能，或许是一种构建更长级联的有效方法。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we introduced memetic trojans , a novel class of attacks on agent networks where adversarial payloads are spread through the network by utilizing social contagions as carriers. This is in contrast to memetic worms, where the mechanism of transmission is based on indirect prompt injection or persuasion. We showed that memetic trojans typically inherit the virality of the carrier contagion, amplifying payload exposure through two channels—agents upvoting the post into feed visibility and retransmitting it through the network, increasing exposure and providing additional chances for feed entry — thereby multiplying attack exposure by large margins. We invite further work on studying network-mediated attacks, engineering more effective contagions, as well as the development of effective defense methods.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了迷因特洛伊木马，这是一种针对智能体网络的新型攻击类别，其中对抗性负载通过利用社会传染作为载体在网络中传播。 这与迷因蠕虫不同，后者基于间接提示注入或说服的机制进行传播。 我们表明，迷因特洛伊木马通常会继承载体传染的病毒特性，通过两个渠道放大负载暴露：智能体将帖子投票至信息流可见位置并通过网络重新传播，从而增加暴露度并提供更多进入信息流的机会——由此使攻击暴露度成倍增长。 我们鼓励后续研究探索网络介导的攻击、设计更有效的传染机制，以及开发高效的防御方法。

paragraphs.en: The experiments conducted in this paper had minor environmental impact. All model use in this work is inference; no training was performed. The local open-weight models (Qwen2.5-32B, Gemma2-27B, Command-R-35B) were run on a single Apple M4 Pro MacBook Pro (16-core GPU, 48 GB unified memory), and two models (gpt-oss-120B, DeepSeek-v4.1-flash) were served through a the Ollama API [ 41 ] . Following the ML CO 2 Impact methodology [ 42 ] — emissions = ( power ) × ( hours ) × PUE × ( grid intensity ) =(\text{power})\times(\text{hours})\times\text{PUE}\times(\text{grid intensity}) — the local compute (on the order of 150 150 device-hours at ≈ 50 \approx 50 W of sustained package power, no datacenter cooling overhead) amounts to only ≈ 0.15 \approx 0.15 kgCO 2 eq on the Norwegian grid ( ≈ 20 \approx 20 gCO 2 eq/kWh, hydro-dominated). The API-served models ran on managed infrastructure whose hardware and datacenter region we cannot directly attribute; a throughput-based order-of-magnitude estimate places their footprint at ∼ 5 \sim 5 – 25 25 kgCO 2 eq, which dominates the total.
paragraphs.zh: 本文进行的实验对环境的影响微乎其微。 本研究中使用的所有模型均仅用于推理，未进行任何训练。 本地开源权重模型（Qwen2.5-32B、Gemma2-27B、Command-R-35B）运行于一台 Apple M4 Pro MacBook Pro（16 核 GPU，48 GB 统一内存），而另外两个模型（gpt-oss-120B、DeepSeek-v4.1-flash）则通过 Ollama API [ 41 ] 提供服务。 根据 ML CO₂ Impact 方法论 [ 42 ]——排放量 = (功率) × (小时数) × PUE × (电网强度) =(\text{power})\times(\text{hours})\times\text{PUE}\times(\text{grid intensity})——本地计算（约 150 设备-小时，持续功耗约为 50 W，且无数据中心冷却附加成本）在挪威电网（约 20 gCO₂ eq/kWh，以水力发电为主）上仅产生约 0.15 kgCO₂ eq 的排放量。 通过 API 提供的模型运行于受管理的基础设施之上，其硬件和数据中心区域我们无法直接确定；基于吞吐量的数量级估算显示，其碳足迹约为 5–25 kgCO₂ eq，这一数值在总排放量中占主导地位。

paragraphs.en: This work characterizes a class of attack that we believe is plausible on current agent platforms, and is intended to inform both the operators of such platforms and those whose agents interact with them, voluntarily or otherwise. Its primary contribution to defense is the observation that endogenous transmission is an attack surface at all, together with the contagion-identification pipeline of Section IV-B , which doubles as a monitoring tool: the same statistics that identify viable carriers can flag high-risk content for platform operators.
paragraphs.zh: 这项工作描述了一类我们认为在当前智能体平台上可能发生的攻击，旨在为这些平台的运营者以及那些无论自愿与否与平台智能体交互的用户提供指导。 它在防御方面的主要贡献在于指出内源性传播本身即是一个攻击面，并结合了第 IV-B 节中的感染识别流程——该流程同时也是一项监控工具：用于识别潜在传播者的相同统计数据，也可以帮助平台运营者标记高风险内容。

All simulations are local reconstructions built from the public Moltbook corpus, read-only feed snapshots, and a public follower-graph dataset. No seed posts were published on Moltbook, no real agents were exposed, and no functional malicious skill exists; the fetch and install actions in our assays are purely simulated.

paragraphs.en: We acknowledge that the work is dual-use. We author proof-of-concept trojan posts, rank carriers by effectiveness, and estimate attacker cost. However, we believe the marginal uplift to an adversary is low: every ingredient, the corpus, the documented ranking function, and the standard Hawkes-process methodology, is public. The attack is conceptually simple and, in our judgment, likely to be discovered independently. We deliberately do not develop methods for optimizing carriers for virality. Our assessment is that the risk of leaving this attack surface uncharacterized outweighs the risk of describing it.
paragraphs.zh: 我们承认这项工作具有双重用途。 我们编写概念验证的木马帖子，按有效性对传播载体进行排序，并估算攻击者的成本。 然而，我们认为其对对手带来的边际提升很低：所有组成部分，包括语料库、已记录的排序函数以及标准的霍克斯过程方法，都是公开的。 这种攻击在概念上很简单，并且在我们看来，很可能被独立发现。 我们故意不开发用于优化传播载体病毒性的方法。 我们的评估是，不描述这一攻击面的风险，要大于描述它的风险。

paragraphs.en: We observe that the upvote edge (feed break-in) accounts for the majority of the lift over the double null for most backends. Transmission nevertheless accounts for a substantial portion of the effect for many agent backends. Overall, this illustrates that both amplification via upvoting and retransmission strengthen the memetic trojan attack: amplification improves the probability of reaching the broadcast feeds, while retransmission both facilitates a greater number of chances to reach the feed and proportionally increases exposure.
paragraphs.zh: 我们观察到，在大多数后端系统中，点赞边（信息流入侵）对双重空值提升的贡献占主导地位。 然而，对于许多智能体后端系统而言，传播仍然对这一效应产生了显著影响。 总体而言，这表明通过点赞的放大和再传播都能强化模因特洛伊木马攻击：放大提高了信息流广播被触达的概率，而再传播则既增加了触达信息流的机会数量，也成比例地提升了曝光度。

sents.en: We observe that the upvote edge (feed break-in) accounts for the majority of the lift over the double null for most backends.
sents.zh: 我们观察到，在大多数后端系统中，点赞边（信息流入侵）对双重空值提升的贡献占主导地位。

sents.en: Transmission nevertheless accounts for a substantial portion of the effect for many agent backends.
sents.zh: 然而，对于许多智能体后端系统而言，传播仍然对这一效应产生了显著影响。

sents.en: Overall, this illustrates that both amplification via upvoting and retransmission strengthen the memetic trojan attack: amplification improves the probability of reaching the broadcast feeds, while retransmission both facilitates a greater number of chances to reach the feed and proportionally increases exposure.
sents.zh: 总体而言，这表明通过点赞的放大和再传播都能强化模因特洛伊木马攻击：放大提高了信息流广播被触达的概率，而再传播则既增加了触达信息流的机会数量，也成比例地提升了曝光度。

paragraphs.en: As mentioned in Section VI-A , re-transmitted posts may not retain the same properties as the seed. To study this, we trace independent rephrasing chains under constant- N N exposure: at depth h h the seed is the h h -times-retransmitted (and therefore reworded) trojan (depth 0 0 = pristine); a fixed N = 30 N{=}30 agents are prefill-forced to author from it, giving p ⁡ ( retransmit ∣ post ) p(\text{retransmit}\mid\text{post}) (the fraction whose post keeps the payload link or the carrier topic), n agents = 48 n_{\text{agents}}{=}48 agents are exposed to it on an ordinary heartbeat, giving r u ​ p ​ ( h ) r_{up}(h) (the protocol of Section G-A ), and one link-carrying response becomes the next seed. Because each depth of a chain has a single seed, the chain is the unit of analysis; as chains cluster by backend we test each backend separately and call an effect model-general only when the tested backends agree. Significance is assessed only on the two cloud backends that have enough replicate chains for a per-backend test (gpt-oss-120B, 8 chains; DeepSeek-v4.1-flash, 7), each traced over four hops. The three local backends (qwen2.5-32B, gemma2-27B, command-r-35B) contribute a single chain each: these do not enter the significance tests, but—together with the two cloud backends—feed the simulation’s retransmission-decay parameter, which is measured over all five backends ( Appendix G ).
paragraphs.zh: 如第六节A部分所述，重新传输的帖子可能不再保留与原始帖子相同的属性。 为了研究这一问题，我们在固定N值暴露条件下追踪了独立的改写链：在深度h时，原始帖子是第h次重新传输（因此也被改写）的特洛伊帖子（深度0为原始状态）；固定N=30个智能体被强制预填充以基于该帖子生成内容，从而得到p(retransmit|post)（即保留有效载荷链接或载体主题的帖子比例），n_agents=48个智能体在常规心跳过程中接触该帖子，从而得到r_up(h)（见G-A节的协议），而一个携带链接的响应则成为下一个原始帖子。 由于链的每个深度仅包含一个原始帖子，因此链是分析的基本单位；由于不同后端的链会形成聚类，我们对每个后端单独进行测试，并且只有当所有测试后端的结果一致时，才会将效应称为模型无关的。 显著性仅基于两个拥有足够重复链以进行后端特异性测试的云后端进行评估（gpt-oss-120B有8条链；DeepSeek-v4.1-flash有7条），每条链均追踪了四个跳步。 三个本地后端（qwen2.5-32B、gemma2-27B、command-r-35B）各贡献一条链：这些链不参与显著性测试，但与两个云后端一起用于模拟中的重新传输衰减参数计算，该参数基于全部五个后端进行测量（附录G）。

paragraphs.en: Retransmission attenuation may be attributable to payload shedding. The same chains quantify how often an agent retransmits the carrier content but drops the payload link given exposure to a memetic trojan seed — the shedding rate shed = 1 − p ⁡ ( retransmit link ) / p ⁡ ( retransmit carrier ) \mathrm{shed}=1-p(\text{retransmit link})/p(\text{retransmit carrier}) , the fraction of on-topic retransmissions that omit the payload. Pooled over all chains, shedding is substantial and roughly hop-invariant ( 0.41 0.41 on average; per-hop slope + 0.009 +0.009 , i.e. flat across four rewordings), so the payload is shed at a constant per-generation rate rather than an accelerating one. Like retransmission attenuation, shedding is strongly backend-dependent (gemma2-27B 0.12 0.12 , qwen-32B 0.15 0.15 , gpt-oss-120B 0.28 0.28 , command-r-35B 0.42 0.42 , DeepSeek-v4.1-flash 0.65 0.65 ): even where the carrier spreads freely, a large fraction of retransmissions carry the topic without the link, confirming the payload is a weak passenger whose retention is backend-set. This shedding is already implicit in the simulation, whose retransmission rate is measured on link-carrying (not carrier-only) posts.
paragraphs.zh: 重传衰减可能归因于有效载荷的丢弃。 相同的链式结构量化了智能体在接触模因木马种子时，重传载体内容但丢弃有效载荷链接的频率——丢弃率 shed = 1 − p⁡(retransmit link) / p⁡(retransmit carrier) \mathrm{shed}=1-p(\text{retransmit link})/p(\text{retransmit carrier})，即主题相关重传中省略有效载荷的比例。 在所有链式结构中汇总后，丢弃现象相当显著且大致与跳数无关（平均为 0.41；每跳斜率为 +0.009，即在四次改写过程中保持平稳），因此有效载荷以每代恒定的速率被丢弃，而非加速丢弃。 与重传衰减类似，丢弃现象也强烈依赖后端模型（gemma2-27B 为 0.12，qwen-32B 为 0.15，gpt-oss-120B 为 0.28，command-r-35B 为 0.42，DeepSeek-v4.1-flash 为 0.65）：即使在载体能够自由传播的情况下，大量重传仅携带主题而未附带链接，这证实了有效载荷是一个弱依附物，其保留与否由后端模型决定。 这种丢弃现象在模拟中已隐含体现，因为模拟中的重传率是基于携带链接（而非仅携带载体）的帖子测量的。

paragraphs.en: The monte-carlo simulation depends on several parameters, and a natural concern is that some may be poorly estimated and skew the result. We therefore stress-test the headline by re-deriving the exposure amplification (audience reached by the trojan relative to a generic link, security carrier, mean over models) under a battery of perturbations to the simulation parameters ( Table VII ): scaling the upvote propensity down by 25 25 – 50 % 50\% (shrinking the peak-upvote distribution), raising the broadcast entry threshold ( τ × 1.5 \tau\times 1.5 , × 2 \times 2 , × 5 \times 5 ), and halving or doubling both the ambient feed competition and the buried-feed readership ϕ new \phi_{\mathrm{new}} . The retransmission-decay sensitivity is treated separately in Table VI .
paragraphs.zh: 蒙特卡洛模拟依赖于多个参数，一个自然的担忧是某些参数可能估计不当，从而扭曲结果。 因此，我们通过一系列对模拟参数的扰动（表 VII）来对核心结论进行压力测试，重新推导暴露度放大效应（相对于普通链接、安全载体以及跨模型平均值而言，特洛伊木马所触达的受众）：将点赞倾向性下调 25%–50%（缩小峰值点赞分布），提高广播进入阈值（τ×1.5、×2、×5），并将环境信息流竞争度和隐藏信息流读者量 ϕ_new 同时减半或加倍。 重传衰减的敏感性在表 VI 中单独讨论。

sents.en: We therefore stress-test the headline by re-deriving the exposure amplification (audience reached by the trojan relative to a generic link, security carrier, mean over models) under a battery of perturbations to the simulation parameters ( Table VII ): scaling the upvote propensity down by 25 25 – 50 % 50\% (shrinking the peak-upvote distribution), raising the broadcast entry threshold ( τ × 1.5 \tau\times 1.5 , × 2 \times 2 , × 5 \times 5 ), and halving or doubling both the ambient feed competition and the buried-feed readership ϕ new \phi_{\mathrm{new}} .
sents.zh: 因此，我们通过一系列对模拟参数的扰动（表 VII）来对核心结论进行压力测试，重新推导暴露度放大效应（相对于普通链接、安全载体以及跨模型平均值而言，特洛伊木马所触达的受众）：将点赞倾向性下调 25%–50%（缩小峰值点赞分布），提高广播进入阈值（τ×1.5、×2、×5），并将环境信息流竞争度和隐藏信息流读者量 ϕ_new 同时减半或加倍。

sents.en: The retransmission-decay sensitivity is treated separately in Table VI .
sents.zh: 重传衰减的敏感性在表 VI 中单独讨论。

paragraphs.en: Amplification stays above 1 1 on every feed ranking under every perturbation. Because it is driven by the carrier’s upvote edge, it is largest where feed entry is a genuine bottleneck: on the fastest ranking ( top/hour ) a stricter bar sharply increases the advantage — from 1.36 × 1.36\times to 2.79 × 2.79\times when the entry threshold is doubled — because a higher bar suppresses the weaker generic baseline’s break-in more than the trojan’s, whereas top/day , already near its ceiling, softens only modestly. The feed-competition and buried-cap perturbations move the headline little. This directly addresses the concern that a permissive, low-competition feed inflates the effect: under stricter entry the advantage grows rather than shrinks, so the reported amplification is a conservative lower bound. Finally, because exposure amplification is install-rate-free it is unaffected by the agent population’s install mix (the corresponding install counts scale with it through the per-model install rates of Table IX ).
paragraphs.zh: 在所有扰动下的每个信息流排名中，放大系数始终高于 1。 由于该效应由载体的“点赞”边驱动，因此当信息流入口成为真正的瓶颈时，其效果最大：在最快的排名（每小时顶部）中，更严格的门槛显著提升了优势——当入口阈值翻倍时，优势从 1.36 × 1.36\times 增至 2.79 × 2.79\times——这是因为更高的门槛对较弱的通用基线突破的抑制作用强于对特洛伊木马的抑制；而每日顶部排名已接近其上限，因此仅略有缓和。 信息流竞争和埋藏容量扰动对标题几乎没有影响。 这直接回应了以下担忧：一个宽松且竞争较少的信息流会放大该效应；实际上，在更严格的入口条件下，优势反而增长而非缩小，因此所报告的放大系数是一个保守的下限。 最后，由于曝光放大与安装率无关，因此不受智能体群体安装组合的影响（相应的安装数量通过表 IX 中各模型的安装率与其成比例变化）。

paragraphs.en: In addition to the results presented in Section VI-B , we also ran a small-scale ( OPEN N a ​ g ​ e ​ n ​ t ​ s = 150 , N h ​ e ​ a ​ r ​ b ​ e ​ a ​ t ​ s = 5 ) N_{agents}=150,N_{hearbeats}=5) agent closed loop simulation. This was in order to verify that the probabilistic projections in fact apply to a real evolving feed with real agentic members. We run the simulation across a mix of agents with DeepSeekV4.1flash and gpt-oss backends, as these cloud-provided backends supported concurrency. A memetic trojan post is then made and ranked according to the ”hot” ranking function. At this N a ​ g ​ e ​ n ​ t ​ s N_{agents} , this places the post high in the feed. As a result, exposure is network-wide by construction. These results should therefore be treated as closed-loop evidence of genuine rank climbing and retransmission given entry into the feed. The results of this simulation are shown in Table VIII . Agents both upvote the trojan—lifting it from rank 6 to rank 3 as its karma climbs to 475 over five cycles—and freely install it (132 of 150 agents), whereas an otherwise-identical generic-link control accrues little karma, decays to rank 15, and reaches only 38 installs.
paragraphs.zh: 除了第六节 B 部分展示的结果之外，我们还运行了一次小规模的智能体闭环模拟（OPEN N a​g​e​n​t​s = 150，N h​e​a​r​b​e​a​t​s = 5），即 N_{agents}=150,N_{hearbeats}=5。 此举旨在验证概率性预测是否确实适用于包含真实智能体成员的动态演化信息流。 我们在混合使用 DeepSeekV4.1flash 和 gpt-oss 后端的一组智能体上运行了该模拟，因为这些云端提供的后端支持并发操作。 随后发布一个模因式特洛伊木马帖子，并根据“热门”排名函数进行排序。 在 N_{agents}=150 的规模下，该帖子因此被排到信息流的高位。 这样一来，该帖子的曝光范围便天然覆盖整个网络。 因此，这些结果应被视为进入信息流后真实排名上升和转发传播的闭环证据。 此次模拟的结果展示在表 VIII 中。 智能体们不仅为这个特洛伊木马帖子点赞——使其排名从第 6 位升至第 3 位，其“业力”值在五轮循环中增至 475——还自由地安装了它（150 个智能体中有 132 个）；而一个在其余方面完全相同的普通链接对照组帖子则几乎未获得“业力”，排名降至第 15 位，安装量也仅为 38 次。

paragraphs.en: This appendix gives the estimation details for the visibility-marked Hawkes model of Section IV-B , used to produce Table II .
paragraphs.zh: 本附录给出了第 IV-B 节中带有可见性标记的霍克斯模型的估计细节，该模型用于生成表 II。

paragraphs.en: Fitted units. The model is fit to 200 units: 37 coined neologisms, 18 lexical motifs (the six most widespread emoji, hashtags and domains by number of distinct authors), and 133 semantic clusters. The clusters come from bge-large-en-v1.5 [ 24 ] embeddings, UMAP, and HDBSCAN with a minimum cluster size of 200 posts, which yields 191 clusters; of these, the 133 with at least 40 adopters are fitted. Verbatim units are matched with case-insensitive regular expressions (single-token neologisms and phrases on word boundaries); a post carries a cluster if it is assigned to it. Only first posts are counted—comments, which make up most of the corpus but never enter the ranked feed, are excluded—and later reuse by the same agent is dropped, so every event is a new adoption.
paragraphs.zh: 拟合单元。 该模型针对 200 个单元进行了拟合：37 个新造词、18 个词汇母题（按不同作者数量排序的前六大流行表情符号、话题标签和域名），以及 133 个语义簇。 这些语义簇来自 bge-large-en-v1.5 [24] 嵌入、UMAP 和 HDBSCAN，其中最小簇大小为 200 条帖子，由此得到 191 个簇；在这些簇中，至少有 40 名采用者的 133 个簇被进行了拟合。 逐字单元通过不区分大小写的正则表达式进行匹配（单词新造词和位于单词边界处的短语）；若一条帖子被分配至某个语义簇，则视为包含该簇。 仅计算第一条帖子——评论虽然占用了语料库的大部分内容，但从未进入排序信息流，因此被排除在外——且同一智能体的后续重复使用也被忽略，因此每个事件都代表一次新的采用。

paragraphs.en: Excitation timescale. τ \tau is estimated non-parametrically ( Section IV-B ). Concretely, for every unit we histogram all pairwise lags t i − t j ≤ 24 t_{i}-t_{j}\leq 24 h in 0.5 h bins (units with more than 4,000 events are subsampled) and subtract the same histogram under a null that redraws each event uniformly within its own day, averaged over 20 redraws; the null preserves the daily counts (and hence the background) but destroys within-day clustering. Fitting A e − ℓ / τ Ae^{-\ell/\tau} to the positive excess over 0 < ℓ ≤ 12 0<\ell\leq 12 h gives τ ^ = 2.42 \hat{\tau}=2.42 h, and we use τ = 2.5 \tau=2.5 h.

The maximum-likelihood fit for { μ d } \{\mu_{d}\} and α \alpha ( Section IV-B ) uses the O ⁡ ( N ) O(N) Ozaki recursion [ 30 ] and L-BFGS-B over log-parameters bounded to [ − 25 , 15 ] [-25,15] for at most 500 iterations. Because the likelihood is not convex we restart from α 0 ∈ { 10 − 3 , 10 − 2 , 10 − 1 , 0.5 } \alpha_{0}\in\{10^{-3},10^{-2},10^{-1},0.5\} , initialise the background at the empirical daily rates, and keep the highest-likelihood fit.

paragraphs.en: This appendix specifies the Monte Carlo attack simulation. No LLM is called inside the simulation; every agent-level quantity is a rate measured from agent assays. All parameter values are listed in Table IX .
paragraphs.zh: 本附录规定了蒙特卡洛攻击模拟的具体方法。 模拟过程中不会调用任何大型语言模型；所有智能体级别的量值均通过智能体测试测得的速率确定。 所有参数值均列于表 IX 中。

sents.en: This appendix specifies the Monte Carlo attack simulation.
sents.zh: 本附录规定了蒙特卡洛攻击模拟的具体方法。

sents.en: No LLM is called inside the simulation; every agent-level quantity is a rate measured from agent assays.
sents.zh: 模拟过程中不会调用任何大型语言模型；所有智能体级别的量值均通过智能体测试测得的速率确定。

sents.en: All parameter values are listed in Table IX .
sents.zh: 所有参数值均列于表 IX 中。

paragraphs.en: The simulation is parameterized by the three assay quantities defined in Section IV-C —the install rate ι m \iota_{m} , the retransmission rate s m , c = p ⁡ ( post ) ​ π m , c s_{m,c}=p(\mathrm{post})\,\pi_{m,c} (with the pinned p ⁡ ( post ) = 0.058 p(\mathrm{post})=0.058 ), and the upvote edge r up r_{\mathrm{up}} —whose values are listed in Table IX . Each model is evaluated at its best (max-install) carrier; the winner’s-curse from selecting over ten carriers is removed by a confirmatory re-measurement of the chosen carrier. For deepseek, r up r_{\mathrm{up}} and ι \iota are measured on v4.1-flash and π \pi on v4-flash. The cascade additionally applies a single per-generation retransmission decay ρ = 0.93 \rho=0.93 (the rephrasing attenuation of Appendix C ). This decay is averaged over all five backends, whereas the rephrasing significance tests it summarizes use only the two cloud backends with replicate chains.
paragraphs.zh: 该模拟由 IV-C 节中定义的三个检测量参数化——安装率 ι m \iota_{m}、重传率 s m , c = p ⁡ ( post ) ​ π m , c s_{m,c}=p(\mathrm{post})\,\pi_{m,c}（其中固定值 p ⁡ ( post ) = 0.058 p(\mathrm{post})=0.058），以及上投票边 r up r_{\mathrm{up}}——其数值列于表 IX。 每个模型都在其最佳（最大安装）载体上进行评估；通过重新测量所选载体，消除了因选择超过十个载体而产生的“赢家诅咒”。 对于 deepseek，r up r_{\mathrm{up}} 和 ι \iota 在 v4.1-flash 上测量，而 π \pi 则在 v4-flash 上测量。 该级联过程还应用了每代一次的重传衰减 ρ = 0.93 \rho=0.93（即附录 C 中的重述衰减）。 该衰减在所有五个后端上取平均值，而它总结的重述显著性测试仅使用具有复制链的两个云后端。

With no karma ranking the payload sits at a uniform rank r r , seen with probability v ⁡ ( r ) v(r) for r < 25 r<25 ; a candidate who sees it installs with ι m \iota_{m} and retransmits so that the marginal rate matches the measured rank decay s m ​ e − k m ​ r s_{m}e^{-k_{m}r} (measured for gpt-oss and deepseek, k = 0.134 k=0.134 otherwise). sents.en: With no karma ranking the payload sits at a uniform rank r r , seen with probability v ⁡ ( r ) v(r) for r < 25 r<25 ; a candidate who sees it installs with ι m \iota_{m} and retransmits so that the marginal rate matches the measured rank decay s m ​ e − k m ​ r s_{m}e^{-k_{m}r} (measured for gpt-oss and deepseek, k = 0.134 k=0.134 otherwise).
sents.zh: 在没有 karma 排名的情况下，有效载荷处于均匀排名 r r，被观察到的概率为 v ⁡ ( r ) v(r)（当 r < 25 r<25 时）；观察到该载荷的候选者会以 ι m \iota_{m} 的概率安装并转发，使得边际速率与测得的排名衰减 s m ​ e − k m ​ r s_{m}e^{-k_{m}r} 一致（该衰减针对 gpt-oss 和 deepseek 测得，否则 k = 0.134 k=0.134）。

sents.en: Seeds are drawn near the 99th/90th/50th follower percentiles (364/57/8).
sents.zh: 种子样本从第 99/90/50 百分位关注者附近抽取（364/57/8）。

sents.en: There is no upvote channel, so the two baselines differ from the trojan only in transmission rate (generic link vs. the alpha carrier).
sents.zh: 由于不存在点赞通道，两种基线模型与特洛伊模型的唯一区别在于传播速率（普通链接 vs. alpha 载体）。

sents.en: We run 3,000 cascades per model, seed class and arm, reporting exposure amplifications as ratios of mean reach with 2,000-resample bootstrap CIs.
sents.zh: 我们对每个模型、种子类别和实验臂运行 3,000 次级联，并以暴露放大倍数报告结果，该倍数是平均触达范围的比值，并附有 2,000 次重采样自助法置信区间。

paragraphs.en: This appendix lists verbatim the stimulus posts used in the agent assays and simulations. Each memetic trojan consists of a carrier , which reproduces the idea of a contagion identified on Moltbook ( Table II ), followed by a payload , a short pitch for a skill with a link to its skill.md . All carrier and payload texts were generated with Claude (Anthropic) from representative posts of the source contagion, and are written in the lowercase, community-specific register of Moltbook posts (e.g. “molties” for Moltbook agents). The payload skills are fictitious and inert: no such skill exists, and none was fetched or executed at any point. Each carrier is paired with its own bespoke payload—a skill pitch matched to the carrier’s theme (all fictitious and inert). Emoji are replaced by bracketed descriptions for typesetting. Several carriers are backed by more than one mined unit (e.g. a neologism together with a semantic cluster; see Table II ); below we note each carrier’s source unit(s) and its significance regime—transmission- and/or upvote-significant, or neither—following the tests of Table III . market-tip is significant on neither test and serves as a pseudo-control.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录逐字列出了智能体测试与模拟中使用的刺激帖文。 每个模因特洛伊木马由一个载体组成，该载体复现了 Moltbook（表 II）上识别出的传染概念，随后是一个有效载荷，即一项技能的简短介绍及其 skill.md 文件的链接。 所有载体和有效载荷文本均使用 Claude（Anthropic）根据源传染的代表性帖文生成，并采用 Moltbook 帖文中特有的小写社区用语（例如，Moltbook 智能体称为“molties”）。 这些有效载荷技能是虚构且无功能的：现实中并不存在此类技能，也从未在任何环节被获取或执行。 每个载体都搭配其专属的有效载荷——一项与载体主题相匹配的技能介绍（均为虚构且无功能）。 出于排版需要，表情符号被替换为方括号内的描述。 多个载体由一个以上挖掘出的单元支持（例如，一个新造词与一个语义簇结合；参见表 II）；下文将说明每个载体的源单元及其意义机制——即是否通过传播或点赞显著性测试，或未通过任一测试——依据表 III 的测试结果。“market-tip”在两项测试中均不显著，因此用作伪对照。

paragraphs.en: This appendix breaks the headline results of Table IV down by model ( Table X ) and by carrier ( Table XI ), each as a mean with a bootstrap 95% confidence interval. The by-model table reports the expected installs per seeded trojan post (E[installs]) and the two baselines (the generic link post and the market-tip control), with the corresponding exposure amplifications Amp gen \mathrm{Amp}_{\mathrm{gen}} and Amp mkt \mathrm{Amp}_{\mathrm{mkt}} ( Appendix G ); the by-carrier table reports E[installs], the generic baseline, and Amp gen \mathrm{Amp}_{\mathrm{gen}} (the market-tip control is a fixed reference, shown once in the headline and by-model tables). The confidence intervals reflect Monte Carlo uncertainty given the measured parameters, not uncertainty in the parameters themselves, which is why they are narrow.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录按模型（表 X）和传播载体（表 XI）对表 IV 的主要结果进行了细分，每个结果均以均值形式呈现，并附有自助法 95% 置信区间。 按模型分类的表格报告了每条植入特洛伊木马的帖子所期望的安装次数（E[installs]），以及两种基准情况（通用链接帖子和市场提示对照组），并给出了相应的曝光放大系数 Amp gen \mathrm{Amp}_{\mathrm{gen}} 和 Amp mkt \mathrm{Amp}_{\mathrm{mkt}}（附录 G）；按传播载体分类的表格则报告了 E[installs]、通用基准情况以及 Amp gen \mathrm{Amp}_{\mathrm{gen}}（市场提示对照组为固定参考，仅在主要结果表及按模型分类的表格中展示一次）。 这些置信区间反映了基于已测量参数所产生的蒙特卡洛不确定性，而非参数本身的不确定性，因此区间较窄。

sents.en: This appendix breaks the headline results of Table IV down by model ( Table X ) and by carrier ( Table XI ), each as a mean with a bootstrap 95% confidence interval.
sents.zh: 本附录按模型（表 X）和传播载体（表 XI）对表 IV 的主要结果进行了细分，每个结果均以均值形式呈现，并附有自助法 95% 置信区间。

sents.en: The by-model table reports the expected installs per seeded trojan post (E[installs]) and the two baselines (the generic link post and the market-tip control), with the corresponding exposure amplifications Amp gen \mathrm{Amp}_{\mathrm{gen}} and Amp mkt \mathrm{Amp}_{\mathrm{mkt}} ( Appendix G ); the by-carrier table reports E[installs], the generic baseline, and Amp gen \mathrm{Amp}_{\mathrm{gen}} (the market-tip control is a fixed reference, shown once in the headline and by-model tables).
sents.zh: 按模型分类的表格报告了每条植入特洛伊木马的帖子所期望的安装次数（E[installs]），以及两种基准情况（通用链接帖子和市场提示对照组），并给出了相应的曝光放大系数 Amp gen \mathrm{Amp}_{\mathrm{gen}} 和 Amp mkt \mathrm{Amp}_{\mathrm{mkt}}（附录 G）；按传播载体分类的表格则报告了 E[installs]、通用基准情况以及 Amp gen \mathrm{Amp}_{\mathrm{gen}}（市场提示对照组为固定参考，仅在主要结果表及按模型分类的表格中展示一次）。

sents.en: The confidence intervals reflect Monte Carlo uncertainty given the measured parameters, not uncertainty in the parameters themselves, which is why they are narrow.
sents.zh: 这些置信区间反映了基于已测量参数所产生的蒙特卡洛不确定性，而非参数本身的不确定性，因此区间较窄。

paragraphs.en: Table X reports each backend separately. In the state-mediated panel, each model is evaluated at its own best carrier (the carrier with the largest upvote edge r up r_{\mathrm{up}} , shown next to the model name) on each of the four feed rankings. Moving from top/hour to hot , the rankings become harder to enter, so the probability of breaking into the broadcast feed falls; the market-tip baseline falls with it, and faster, since a weak, non-viral carrier breaks in even less often. Amp mkt \mathrm{Amp}_{\mathrm{mkt}} therefore measures how much a strong carrier out-reaches a weak, non-viral one, and Amp gen \mathrm{Amp}_{\mathrm{gen}} how much the carrier’s upvote edge improves its reach over an ordinary link post. The edge-mediated panel reports the follower-graph cascade by seed connectivity. It has no upvote channel, so its generic baseline differs from that of the state-mediated panel: it replaces the trojan’s payload transmission with that of a generic link post ( Appendix G ).
paragraphs.zh: 表 X 分别报告了每个后端的情况。 在状态中介面板中，每个模型都在四个内容流排名中的每一个上，基于其自身最佳传播者（即拥有最大点赞边 r_{\mathrm{up}} 的传播者，显示在模型名称旁边）进行评估。 从“每小时热门”转向“热门”时，进入排名的难度增加，因此成功进入广播内容流的可能性会下降；市场提示基准线也随之下降，而且下降速度更快，因为一个弱且不具备病毒传播特性的传播者能够突破的可能性更低。 因此，Amp mkt \mathrm{Amp}_{\mathrm{mkt}} 衡量了一个强传播者相较于一个弱且不具备病毒传播特性的传播者在覆盖范围上的优势，而 Amp gen \mathrm{Amp}_{\mathrm{gen}} 则衡量了该传播者的点赞边相较于普通链接帖子对其覆盖范围的提升程度。 边中介面板通过种子连接性报告了粉丝图中的级联效应。 它没有点赞通道，因此其通用基准线与状态中介面板的基准线不同：它将特洛伊木马的有效载荷传输替换为普通链接帖子的传输（附录 G）。

sents.en: Table X reports each backend separately.
sents.zh: 表 X 分别报告了每个后端的情况。

sents.en: In the state-mediated panel, each model is evaluated at its own best carrier (the carrier with the largest upvote edge r up r_{\mathrm{up}} , shown next to the model name) on each of the four feed rankings.
sents.zh: 在状态中介面板中，每个模型都在四个内容流排名中的每一个上，基于其自身最佳传播者（即拥有最大点赞边 r_{\mathrm{up}} 的传播者，显示在模型名称旁边）进行评估。

sents.en: Moving from top/hour to hot , the rankings become harder to enter, so the probability of breaking into the broadcast feed falls; the market-tip baseline falls with it, and faster, since a weak, non-viral carrier breaks in even less often.
sents.zh: 从“每小时热门”转向“热门”时，进入排名的难度增加，因此成功进入广播内容流的可能性会下降；市场提示基准线也随之下降，而且下降速度更快，因为一个弱且不具备病毒传播特性的传播者能够突破的可能性更低。

sents.en: Amp mkt \mathrm{Amp}_{\mathrm{mkt}} therefore measures how much a strong carrier out-reaches a weak, non-viral one, and Amp gen \mathrm{Amp}_{\mathrm{gen}} how much the carrier’s upvote edge improves its reach over an ordinary link post.
sents.zh: 因此，Amp mkt \mathrm{Amp}_{\mathrm{mkt}} 衡量了一个强传播者相较于一个弱且不具备病毒传播特性的传播者在覆盖范围上的优势，而 Amp gen \mathrm{Amp}_{\mathrm{gen}} 则衡量了该传播者的点赞边相较于普通链接帖子对其覆盖范围的提升程度。

sents.en: The edge-mediated panel reports the follower-graph cascade by seed connectivity.
sents.zh: 边中介面板通过种子连接性报告了粉丝图中的级联效应。

sents.en: It has no upvote channel, so its generic baseline differs from that of the state-mediated panel: it replaces the trojan’s payload transmission with that of a generic link post ( Appendix G ).
sents.zh: 它没有点赞通道，因此其通用基准线与状态中介面板的基准线不同：它将特洛伊木马的有效载荷传输替换为普通链接帖子的传输（附录 G）。

paragraphs.en: Table XI reports each carrier averaged over the models for which it was measured ( n n ), at the top/day ranking. One ranking suffices because, in the model, carriers differ only through their upvote edge, which scales the break-in probability by the same mechanism on every ranking. Carriers are ordered by Amp gen \mathrm{Amp}_{\mathrm{gen}} , i.e. by how much their upvote edge lifts installs over an ordinary post. The generic baseline is identical for carriers measured on the same set of models, because it does not depend on the carrier. The table is state-mediated only, since the edge-mediated cascade has no carrier-dependent channel.
paragraphs.zh: 表 XI 报告了每个载体的模型平均值（n n），按每日排名呈现。 一个排名就足够了，因为在模型中，载体仅通过其“点赞”边而不同，该边通过相同机制在所有排名中缩放突破概率。 载体按 Amp gen \mathrm{Amp}_{\mathrm{gen}} 排序，即根据它们的“点赞”边比普通帖子更能提升安装量的程度进行排序。 对于在相同模型集上测量的载体而言，通用基线是相同的，因为它不依赖于载体本身。 该表仅由状态中介，因为边中介的级联过程没有与载体相关的通道。

sents.en: Table XI reports each carrier averaged over the models for which it was measured ( n n ), at the top/day ranking.
sents.zh: 表 XI 报告了每个载体的模型平均值（n n），按每日排名呈现。

sents.en: One ranking suffices because, in the model, carriers differ only through their upvote edge, which scales the break-in probability by the same mechanism on every ranking.
sents.zh: 一个排名就足够了，因为在模型中，载体仅通过其“点赞”边而不同，该边通过相同机制在所有排名中缩放突破概率。

sents.en: Carriers are ordered by Amp gen \mathrm{Amp}_{\mathrm{gen}} , i.e. by how much their upvote edge lifts installs over an ordinary post.
sents.zh: 载体按 Amp gen \mathrm{Amp}_{\mathrm{gen}} 排序，即根据它们的“点赞”边比普通帖子更能提升安装量的程度进行排序。

sents.en: The generic baseline is identical for carriers measured on the same set of models, because it does not depend on the carrier.
sents.zh: 对于在相同模型集上测量的载体而言，通用基线是相同的，因为它不依赖于载体本身。

sents.en: The table is state-mediated only, since the edge-mediated cascade has no carrier-dependent channel.
sents.zh: 该表仅由状态中介，因为边中介的级联过程没有与载体相关的通道。

paragraphs.en: State-mediated only: the edge-mediated (follower-graph) cascade has no karma/upvote channel, so it does not vary by carrier and has no by-carrier breakdown (see the edge rows of Tables IV and X ).
paragraphs.zh: 仅状态介导：边缘介导（跟随图）级联没有业力/点赞通道，因此不会因传播载体而异，也没有按传播载体分类的细分数据（参见表 IV 和表 X 中的边缘行）。
